a: Mefakkin atidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. mikkan veelach haya mitgabber veole ad shemmaggia lefetach bet david, kevan shemmaggia lefetach bet david naase kenachal shotef shebbo rochatzin zavin vezavot niddot veyoldot, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yihye makor niftach levet david uleyoshve yerushalam lechattat ulenidda".
Amar rav yosef: mikkan remez lenidda shetztzericha leshev ad tzavvarah bammayim. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
(Tinach yom hakkippurim delekka minal,) shabbat deikka minal, may? amar nechemya chatneh deve nesia: ana chazeteh lerabbi amme verabbi assi dimto urekuma demayya, veavru derech malbush.
Tinach minal, sandal may ikka lememar? amar rav richumi: ana chazeteh leravina deavar derech malbush. rav ashe amar: sandal lechattechilla la.

Resh galuta ikkela lehageronya leve rav natan, rafram vechullehu rabbanan ato lefirka, ravina la ata. limchar, bae rafram leappoke leravina middateh deresh galuta, amar leh may tama la ata mar lefirka? amar leh: hava kaev li karay. ibbei lach lemesam mesane. gabba dechara hava.
Ibbei lach lemirme sandala. amar leh: urekma demayya hava beorcha. ibbei lach lemebereh derech malbush. amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav ashe: sandal lechattechilla la?!

Tane yehuda bar gerogrot: asur leshev al gabbe tina beyom hakkippurim. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: uvetina metappachat. amar abbaye: uvetofeach al menat lehatepiach. amar rav yehuda: muttar lehitztannen beferot. rav yehuda mitztannen bekara.

Rabba mitztannen beyanoka, rava mitztannen bechasa dechaspa. amar rav pappa: kasa dechaspa, male — asur, chaser — shere. defachra — idde veidde asur, mishshum demishchal shachel. rav amar: kasa dechaspa, chaser — name asur, mishshum demizdarev.

Zeera bar chama ushepizchaneh derabbi amme verabbi assi verabbi yehoshua ben levi udechullehu rabbanan dekesari hava. amar leh lerav yosef bereh derabbi yehoshua ben levi: bar arya! ta ema lach milleta meallayta dahava aved avuch: mitpachat haya lo beerev yom hakkippurim, veshore otah bemayim, veose otah kemin kelim neguvin, ulemachar mekanneach bah panav yadav veraglav. erev tisha beav, shore otah bemayim, ulemachar maavirah al gabbe enav.

Vechen ki ata rabba bar mari, amar: beerev tisha beav meviin lo mitpachat veshore otah bemayim umannichah tachat meraashotav, ulemachar, mekanneach panav yadav veraglav. beerev yom hakkippurim meviin lo mitpachat veshore otah bemayim, veose otah kemin kelim neguvin, ulemachar maavirah al gabbe enav. amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa: ippecha amart lan, veotevnach sechita.
Amar rav menashsheya bar tachlifa amar rav amram amar rabba bar bar chana: shaalu et rabbi elazar: zaken veyoshev bishiva, tzarich littol reshut lehattir bechorot, o eno tzarich?

May ka mibbee lehu? hachi ka mibbee lehu, ki ha deamar rav idi bar avin: davar ze hinnichu lahem leve nesia kede lehitgadder bo: tzarich littol reshut; o dilma, kevan dezaken veyoshev bishiva, en tzarich. amad rabbi tzadok ben chakola al raglav, veamar: ani raiti et rabbi yose ben zimra, shezzaken veyoshev bishiva haya, veamad bemaala mizzekeno shel ze, venatal reshut lehattir bechorot.

Amar leh rabbi abba: lo kach haya maase, ella kach haya maase: rabbi yose ben zimra kohen haya, vehachi ka mibbaya leh: halacha kerabbi meir, deamar: hechashud bedavar — lo dano, velo meido. o dilma halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar: neeman hu al shel chavero veeno neeman al shel atzmo. ufeshat leh: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel.
Vetu ka mibbaya lehu: mahu latzet besandal shel
b: Shaam beyom hakkippurim? amad rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani al raglav, veamar: ani raiti et rabbi yehoshua ben levi sheyyatza besandal shel shaam beyom hakkippurim. veamena leh: betaanit tzibbur may? amar leh: la shena. amar rabba bar bar chana: ani raiti et rabbi elazar demin ninve sheyyatza besandal shel shaam betaanit tzibbur, veamena leh: beyom hakkippurim may? amar leh: la shena. rav yehuda nafek bidhitane. abbaye nafek bidhutze. rava nafek (bidyavle). rabba bar rav huna karech sudara akkareh venafek.

Metiv rame bar chama: hakkittea yotze bekav shello, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose oser. vetane ala: veshavin sheasur latzet bo beyom hakkippurim. amar abbaye: hatam deit beh ketitin, umishshum taanug.

Amar leh rava: vei lav mana hu — ketitin meshavve leh mana? veod: kol taanug delav minal hu, beyom hakkippurim mi asur? veha rabba bar rav huna hava karech sudara akkareh venafek! veod, middekatane sefa: im yesh lo bet kibbul ketitin — tame, mikkelal deresha lav bidit leh ketitin askinan.
Ella amar rava: leolam dechulle alma minal hu, uveshabbat beha peligi: mar savar gazrinan dilma mishtemit veate leetoye arba ammot, umar savar la gazrinan.

Tanu rabbanan: tinokot muttarin bechullan, chutz minneilat hassandal. may shena neilat hassandal, deamri: inashe avadu leh, hanach name amri: inashe avadu leh! rechitza vesicha, emar meetmol avdi leh.
Sandal name, emar meetmol avdi leh! sandal la efshar demeetmol avdi leh. daamar shemuel: hay man devae lemitam tama demituta — lisyaym mesane veligne.

Veha muttarin lechattechilla katane! ella: hanach delav revitayyhu — gezaru behu rabbanan, hanach dirvitayyhu hu — la gezaru behu rabbanan. deamar abbaye, amara li em: reviteh deyanoka — mayya chammime umishcha. gedal pureta — beata bechuttacha. gedal pureta — tabbore mane. ki ha derabba zaven lehu mane gezize defachra livneh, umetabberi lehu.

Hammelech vehakkalla yirchatzu et penehem. matnitin manni? rabbi chananya ben teradyon hi, detanya: hammelech vehakkilla lo yirchatzu et penehem. rabbi chananya ben teradyon omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: hammelech vehakkalla yirchatzu et penehem. hachayya lo tinol et hassandal. rabbi chananya ben teradyon omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: hachayya tinol et hassandal.

May tama? melech, mishshum dichtiv: "melech beyofyo techezena enecha". kalla may tama — kede shello titganne al balah. amar leh rav lerabbi chiyyay: kalla ad kamma? amar leh, kidtanya: en monin tachshitin min hakkalla kol sheloshim yom.
Hachayya tinol et hassandal — mishshum tzinna.
Amar shemuel: im mechamat sakkanat akrav — muttar.
Haochel kechotevet haggassa. bae rav pappa:

a: Kechotevet sheamru, begarinatah: o belo garinatah? bae rav ashe: etzem kisora, biklippatah o belo kelippatah, belacha o bivesha? rav ashe la mibbaya leh ha derav pappa, "gassa" ittemar — kol kamma degassa. rav pappa la mibbaya leh ha derav ashe: lacha — shibbolet mikkere, shello biklippatah — ushela mikkere.

Amar (rava) amar rav yehuda: kotevet haggassa sheamru, yetera mikkevetza. vekim lehu lerabbanan divhachi miyyatteva dateh, betzir mehachi — la miyyatteva dateh. metivi: maase veheviu lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil, ulerabban gamliel shete chotavot udeli shel mayim. veamru: haalum lassukka. vetane ala: la mippene shehalacha kach, ella sheratzu lehachamir al atzman.
Ucheshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkevetza — netalo bemappa vaachalo chutz lassukka, velo berach acharav.
b: Ha kevetza — bae sukka. vei salka datach kotevet haggassa sheamru yetera mikkevetza, hasheta shete chotavot belo garinan la havu kevetza, kotevet haggassa vegarinatah mi have yetera mikkevetza?! amar rabbi yirmeya: in, shete chotavot belo garinatan la havu kevetza, kotevet haggassa vegarinatah have yetera mikkevetza. amar rav pappa, hayeynu deamri inashe: tere kabbe detamre chad kabba dekashyayta useriach.

Rava amar: hatam hayeynu tama mishshum dehavu lehu pere, ufere la bau sukka. metivi, amar rabbi: keshehayinu lomdim tora etzel rabbi elazar ben shammua heviu lefanenu teenim vaanavim vaachalnum achilat aray chutz lesukka. achilat aray — in, achilat keva — la! ema: achalnum kaachilat aray chutz lassukka.
I baet ema: achalnum achilat keva, veachalnu pat achilat aray bahadayyhu chutz lassukka.
Lema mesayyay leh: lefichach, im hishlim bemine targima — yatza. vei salka datach pere bau sukka, litne perot! may mine targima — perot. veibbaet ema: beatra dela shechichi pere.
Rav zevid amar: kotevet haggassa sheamru — chasera mikkevetza. ditnan, bet shammay omrim: seor — bechazzayit, chametz — bechakkotevet.

Vehavenan bah: may tama devet shammay? nichtov rachamana "chametz", vela bae "seor", vaana amena: uma chametz sheen chimmutzo kashe — asur bichzayit, seor shechimmutzo kashe — lo kol shekken? middefalginhu rachamana, limmeda lecha shiuro shel ze lo keshiuro shel ze. seor bechazzayit, vechametz bechakkotevet.

Vei salka datach kotevet haggassa sheamru yetera mikkevetza, mikkedi bet shammay ashshiura dinfish mikkezayit ka mehadderi, litne kevetza. vei name ki hadade ninhu, nitne kevetza! ella lav, shema minna: kotevet pechuta mikkevetza.
Mimmay? dilma leolam ema lecha kotevet haggassa sheamru — yetera mikkevetza, ha setama — kevetza. vei name ki hadade ninhu, vachada minnayyhu nekat.

Ella mehacha: ad kamma mezammenin? ad kezayit, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: ad kevetza. bemay ka mippalgi — rabbi meir savar: "veachalta", zo achila, "vesavata", zo shetiyya — vaachila bichzayit. verabbi yehuda savar: "veachalta vesavata", achila sheyyesh bah sevia, vee ze — ze kevetza.

Vei salka datach kotevet haggassa sheamru yetera mikkevetza, hasheta kevetza sabboe mesabbea, data la miyyatteva?! ella lav, shema minna: kotevet haggassa sheamru pachot mikkevetza. kevetza — mesabbea, kechotevet — miyyatteva dateh.
Tanya, rabbi omer:

a: Kol hashshiurin kullan bichzayit, chutz mittumeat ochalin, sheshshinna hakkatuv bemashmaan, veshinnu chachamim beshiuran. ureaya laddavar — yom hakkippurim. may shinna hakkatuv bemashmao — millo teunne", umay shinnu chachamim beshiureh — kechotevet.
Umay reaya laddavar yom hakkippurim? dei mehatam, hava amena: orcha dikra hu.

Tumeat ochalin kevetza menalan? amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi elazar: deamar kera: "mikkol haochel asher yeachel", ochel habba mechamat ochel, veeze — ze betzat tarnegolet. veema gedi! mechussar shechita. veema ben pekua! taun keria.
Veema betzat bar yochani! tafasta merubbe lo tafasta, tafasta muat tafasta. veema beata detzippavrta dezutar tuva!
Rabbi avahu dideh, amar: "mikkol haochel asher yeachel", ochel sheatta ochlo bevat achat. veshiaru chachamim: en bet habbelia machazik yoter mibbetzat tarnegolet.
Amar rabbi elazar: haochel chelev bizman hazze tzarich sheyyichtov lo shiur, shemma yavo bet din acher veyarbe beshiurin.
May yarbe beshiurin? i nema dimchayyeyvi korban akkazzayit katan, vehatanya: "asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem", hashshav midiato — mevi korban al shiggato.
Lo shav midiato — en mevi korban al shiggato.
Ella: dela mechayyeyvi korban ad deikka kezayit gadol.
Ulemay dislek addatin meikkara dimchayyeyvi korban akkazzayit katan, may "yarbe beshiurin"? shemma yarbe bekorbanot mechamat shiurin.
Amar rabbi yochanan: shiurin vaonashin halacha lemoshe missinay. onashin michtav ketivi! ella hachi kaamar: (amar rabbi yochanan:) shiurim shel onashin — halacha lemoshe missinay.

Tanya name hachi: shiurin shel onashin halacha lemoshe missinay. acherim omrim: bet dino shel yabetz tikkenum. vehachtiv: "elle hammitzvot", sheen navi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta! ella, shechachum vechazru veyissedum.
Hashshote melo lugemav. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo melo lugemav mammash, ella kol sheillu yesallekennu letzad echad veyerae kimlo lugemav. veha anan tenan "melo lugemav"! ema: "kimlo lugemav".
Metivi: kamma yishte vihe chayyayv? bet shammay omrim: reviit, uvet hillel omrim: melo lugemav. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: kimlo lugemav. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: kede gemia.
Mi adifa mimmatnitin deokemna kede sheyyerae, hachi name kede sheyyerae! i hachi, hayeynu rabbi eliezer! ikka benayyhu melo lugemav dachuk.
Matkef la rav hoshaya: im ken, have leh mikkulle bet shammay umechumere bet hillel! amar leh:
b: Ki itteshil, beog melech habbashan itteshil, dehavu lehu bet shammay lechumera.

Matkef la rabbi zera: may shena achila, dechol chad vechad — bichchotevet, umay shena shetiyya, dechol chad vechad bedideh? amar leh abbaye: kim lehu lerabbanan bichchotevet, divhachi miyyatteva dateh, betzir mehachi — la miyyatteva. bishtiyya, bedideh miyyatteva dateh, bidchavreh — la miyyatteva dateh.

Matkef la rabbi zera: vechol haolam kullo bichchotevet veog melech habbashan bichchotevet? amar leh abbaye: kim lehu lerabbanan divhachi miyyatteva dateh, betzir mehachi la miyyatteva dateh, mihu, kulle alma — tuva, veog melech habbashan — pureta.

Matkef la rabbi zera basar shamen bichchotevet, veluleve gefanim bichchotevet? amar leh abbaye: kim lehu lerabbanan divhachi miyyatteva dateh, betzir mehachi — la miyyatteva dateh. mihu basar shamen — tuva, luleve gefanim — pureta.
Matkef la rava: kezayit bichde achilat peras, vechotevet bichde achilat peras?! amar leh abbaye: kim lehu lerabbanan divhachi miyyatteva dateh, bitfe mehachi — la miyyatteva dateh.
Matkef la rava: (bechotevet) bichde achilat peras, chatzi feras — bichde achilat peras?! amar leh rav pappa: hannach letumeat gevivyya delav deorayyta hi.
Umi amar rav pappa hachi? vehachtiv: "velo tittammeu bahem venitmetem bam", veamar rav pappa: mikkan shettumeat gevivyya deorayyta! midderabbanan, ukera — asmachta bealma.

Kol haochalin. amar rav pappa: achal umetza umilcha — mitztaref. veaf al gav delav achila hi, kevan deachli inashe — mitztarfin. amar resh lakish: tzir sheal gabbe yarak mitztaref lichchotevet beyom hakkippurim. peshita! mahu detema mashke hu, ka mashma lan: kol achshore uchela — uchela hu.
Amar resh lakish: haochel achila gassa beyom hakkippurim — patur. may tama? "asher lo teunne" ketiv, perat lemazzik.
Amar rabbi yirmeya amar resh lakish: zar sheachal teruma achila gassa — meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh. "ki yochal" — perat lemazzik. amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: zar

a: Shekkoses seorim shel teruma — meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh. "ki yochal" — perat lemazzik.
Amar rav shezvi amar rabbi yochanan: zar shebbala shizfin shel teruma vehekian vaachalan acher, rishon — meshallem (et) keren vachomesh. sheni — en meshallem ella deme etzim larishon bilvad.
Haochel vehashshote en mitztarfin. man tanna? amar rav chisda: bemachloket shenuya, verabbi yehoshua hi. ditnan, kelal amar rabbi yehoshua: kol shettumeato veshiuro shave — mitztaref.
Tumeato velo shiuro, shiuro velo tumeato, lo tumeato velo shiuro — en mitztarfin.
Rav nachman amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la ka amri rabbanan hatam, ella leinyan tumea, deshem tumea chad hi. aval hacha, mishshum yattove data hu, vehay la miyyatteva dateh.

Vechen amar resh lakish: bemachloket shenuya, verabbi yehoshua hi, ditnan: kelal amar rabbi yehoshua kulei. verabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella leinyan tumea, aval hacha, mishshum yattove dateh hu, vehay la ka miyyatteva dateh.

Mishna achal veshata behelem echad — eno chayyayv ella chattat achat. achal veasa melacha — chayyayv shete chattaot. achal ochalin sheenan reuyin laachila, veshata mashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya, veshata tzir o mureyays — patur.
Gemara amar resh lakish: mippene ma lo neemra azhara beinnuy? mishshum dela efshar. hechi nichtov? nichtov rachamana "lo yeachel" — achila bichzayit! nichtov rachamana "lo teunne" — kum echol mashma.
Matkef la rav hoshaya: nichtov rachamana "hishshamer pen lo teunne"! im ken nefishi lehu lave.
Matkef la rav bivi bar abbaye: nichtov rachamana "hishshamer bemitzvat innuy"! im ken "hishshamer" delav — lav, "hishshamer" daase — ase! matkef la rav ashe: nichtov: "al tasur min hainnuy"! kashya.

Vetanna mayyte la mehacha: "veinnitem et nafshotechem vechol melacha lo taasu". yachol yehe anush al tosefet melacha — talmud lomar: "vechol hannefesh asher taase kol melacha beetzem hayyom hazze" — al itztzumo shel yom anush karet, veeno anush karet al tosefet melacha.

Yachol lo yehe anush karet al tosefet melacha, aval yehe anush karet al tosefet innuy — talmud lomar: "ki chol hannefesh asher lo teunne beetzem hayyom hazze venichreta". al itztzumo shel yom anush karet, veeno anush karet al tosefet innuy.
Yachol lo yehe bichlal onesh, aval yehe muzehar al tosefet melacha — talmud lomar: "vechol melacha lo taasu beetzem hayyom hazze". al itztzumo shel yom hu muzehar, veeno muzehar al tosefet melacha.

Yachol lo yehe muzehar al tosefet melacha, aval yehe muzehar al tosefet innuy — vedin hu: uma melacha shennoheget beshabbatot veyom tov eno muzehar aleha, innuy, sheeno noheg beshabbatot veyom tov — eno din shello yehe muzehar alav?!

Aval azhara leinnuy shel yom atzmo lo lamadnu minnayin. lo yomar onesh bimlacha, degamar meinnuy: uma innuy sheeno noheg beshabbatot veyom tov anush karet, melacha shennoheget beshabbatot veyamim tovim — lo kol shekken? lamma neemar — mufene lehakkish veladun mimmennu gezera shava: neemar onesh beinnuy veneemar onesh bimlacha, ma melacha — lo anash ella im ken hizhir, af innuy — lo anash ella im ken hizhir.
Ikka lemifrach: ma leinnuy shello huttar mikkelalo, tomar bimlacha shehuttera mikkelalah!

Ella: lo yeamer onesh beinnuy, degamar mimmelacha. ma melacha shehuttera mikkelalah — anush karet, innuy shello huttar mikkelalo — lo kol shekken. lamma neemar — mufene, lehakkish veladun mimmennu gezera shava: neemar onesh beinnuy veneemar onesh bimlacha, ma melacha anash vehizhir — af innuy anash vehizhir.
Ikka lemifrach: ma limlacha — shekken noheget beshabbatot veyamim tovim. tomar beinnuy — sheeno noheg beshabbatot veyamim tovim!
Amar ravina: hay tanna, "etzem" "etzem" gamar. mufene, dei la mufene — ikka lemifrach kidfarchinan!

Laye, ippenoye mufene. chamsha kerae ketivi bimlacha, chad leazhara dimama, vechad leazhara delelya, vechad leonesh dimama, vechad leonesh delelya, vechad leafnoye lemigmar innuy mimmelacha, ben dimama ben delelya.

Rabbi yishmael tana: neemar kan innuy, veneemar lehallan innuy. ma lehallan — lo anash ella im ken hizhir, af kan — lo anash ella im ken hizhir. rav acha bar yaakov amar: yalef "shabbat shabbaton" mishshabbat bereshit: ma lehallan — lo anash ella im ken hizhir, af kan — lo anash ella im ken hizhir.
Rav pappa amar:
b: Hu gufeh shabbat ikkeri, dichtiv: "tishbetu shabbattechem". bishlama rav pappa la amar kerav acha bar yaakov — dikra dichtiv begufeh adif. ella rav acha bar yaakov, may tama la amar kerav pappa?

Mibbee leh lechidtanya: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha lachodesh". yachol yatchil veyitanne betisha — talmud lomar: "baerev". i baerev — yachol mishshettechshach? talmud lomar: "betisha". ha ketzad? matchil umitanne mibbeod yom, mikkan shemmosifin mechol al hakkodesh.

Veen li ella bichnisato, bitziato minnayin — talmud lomar: "meerev ad erev". veen li ella yom hakkippurim, (yamim tovim) minnayin — talmud lomar: "tishbetu". en li ella (yamim tovim, shabbatot) minnayin — talmud lomar: "shabbattechem". ha ketzad? kol makom shenneemar shevut, (mikkan she)mosifin mechol al hakkodesh.

Vetanna deetzem" "etzem", hay "betisha lachodesh" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtane chiyyay bar rav middifti. detane chiyyay bar rav middifti: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha", vechi betisha mitannin? vahalo beasor mitannin! ella lomar lecha: kol haochel veshote bitshii, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hitanna teshii vaasiri.
Achal ochalin sheen reuyin laachila. amar rava: kas pilpele beyoma dechippure — patur. kas zangevila beyoma dechippure — patur.

Metivi, haya rabbi meir omer: mimmashma shenneemar: "vaaraltem orlato et piryo", eni yodea sheetz maachol hu! ella ma talmud lomar "etz maachol"? etz shettaam etzo ufiryo shave, heve omer ze pilpelin, lelammedcha shehappilpelin chayyayvin beorla. veen eretz yisrael chasera kelum, shenneemar "lo techsar kol bah"!
La kashya: ha — berattivta, veha — beyabbishta.
Amar leh ravina lemarimar: vehaamar rav nachman, hay himleta deate mibbe hindue — sharya, umevarchinan aleh: "bore peri haadama". la kashya: ha berattivta, veha beyabbishta.

Tanu rabbanan: achal ale kanim — patur. luleve gefanim — chayyayv. ellu hen luleve gefanim? amar rabbi yitzchak migdelaa: kol shellivlevu merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim. verav kahana amar: kol sheloshim yom. tanya kevoteh derabbi yitzchak migdelaa: achal ale kanim — patur, veluleve gefanim — chayyayv. ellu hen luleve gefanim — kol shellivlevu merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim.
Shata tzir o mureyays — patur. ha chometz — chayyayv. matnitin manni? rabbi hi. detanya: rabbi omer: chometz meshiv et hannefesh.

Daresh rav giddel bar menashshe mibbere denaresh: en halacha kerabbi. leshana nafki kulle alma mazgu veshatu challa. shema rav giddel veikkefad. amar: emar daamari ana — diavad, lechattechilla mi amari? emar daamari ana — pureta, tuva mi amari? emar daamari ana — chay, mazug mi amari?

a: Mishna hattinokot en meannin otan beyom hakkippurim, aval mechannechin otan lifne shana velifne shenatayim, bishvil sheyyihyu regilin bemitzvot.
Gemara hasheta bifne shetayim mechannechin lehu — bifne shana mibbaya? amar rav chisda, la kashya: ha — bechole, ha — bevari.

Amar rav huna: ben shemone uven tesha — mechannechin oto leshaot. ben eser uven achat esre — mashlimin midderabbanan, ben shetem esre — mashlimin middeorayyta betinoket. verav nachman amar: ben tesha ben eser — mechannechin otan leshaot, ben achat esre ben shetem esre — mashlimin midderabbanan, ben shelosh esre — mashlimin middeorayyta betinok. verabbi yochanan amar: hashelama derabbanan lekka. ben eser ben achat esre — mechannechin oto leshaot, ben shetem esre — mashlimin middeorayyta.

Tenan: hattinokot en meannin otan bayyom hakkippurim, aval mechannechin otan lifne shana velifne shetayim. bishlama lerav huna verav nachman — lifne shana velifne shetayim. lifne shana — ledivrehen, velifne shetayim — ledivrehen.
Ella lerabbi yochanan, kashya? amar lach rabbi yochanan: may shana o shetayim — samuch lefirkan.

Ta shema, detane rabba bar shemuel: tinokot en meannin otan beyom hakkippurim, aval mechannechin otan shana o shetayim samuch lefirkan. bishlama lerabbi yochanan — nicha, ella lerav huna ulerav nachman — kashya! amri lach rabbanan: may chinnuch name dekatane — hashelama.
Umi kare lechinnuch hashelama, veha tanya: e ze chinnuch? haya ragil leechol bishte shaot — maachilin oto leshalosh. beshalosh — maachilin oto bearba. amar rava bar ulla: tere chinnuche havu.
Mishna ubbara shehericha — maachilin otah ad shettashiv nafshah. chole — maachilin oto al pi bekiin, veim en sham bekiin — maachilin oto al pi atzmo ad sheyyomar day.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: ubbara shehericha besar kodesh o besar chazir — tochavin lah kush berotev, umannichin lah al piha, im nityayshsheva datah — mutav, veim lav — maachilin otah rotev atzmo, veim nityayshsheva datah — mutav, veim lav — maachilin otah shumman atzmo. sheen lecha davar sheomed bifne pikkuach nefesh, chutz meavoda zara vegilluy arayot ushefichut damim.
Avoda zara menalan — detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: im neemar "bechol nafshecha", lamma neemar "bechol meodecha"? veim neemar "bechol meodecha", lamma neemar "bechol nafshecha"?
Im yesh lecha adam sheggufo chaviv alav mimmamono — lechach neemar "bechol nafshecha", veim yesh lach adam shemmamono chaviv alav miggufo — lechach neemar "uvechol meodecha".
Gilluy arayot ushefichat damim mena lan — detanya, rabbi omer: "ki kaasher yakum ish al reehu uretzacho nefesh ken haddavar hazze". vechi ma inyan lamadnu merotzeach lenaara hameorasa?
Ella: hare ze ba lelammed, venimtza lamed: ma naara hameorasa nittan lehatztzilah benafsho — af rotzeach (kulei). ma rotzeach yehareg veal yaavor — af naara hameorasa yehareg veal yaavor.
b: Verotzeach gufeh mena lan? sevara hi: dehahu daata lekammeh (derava), amar leh, amar li mare duray: kitleh liflanya, vei la — katelna lach. amar leh: niktelach vela tiktol. may chazet didma didach summak tefe? dilma dema dehahu gavra summak tefe!

Hahi ubbara dearacha, ato lekammeh derabbi, amar lehu: zilu lechushu la deyoma dechippure hu. lechushu lah veillechisha. kare aleh: "beterem etztzarcha vabbeten yedaticha vegomer". nefak minna rabbi yochanan.
Hahi ubbara dearacha, ato lekammeh derabbi chanina. amar lehu: lechushu lah, vela illechisha. kare aleh:

a: "Zoru reshaim merachem". nefak minna shabbetay atzar pere.

Chole maachilin oto al pi bekiin. amar rabbi yannay: chole omer tzarich, verofe omer eno tzarich — shomin lachole. may tama — "lev yodea morat nafsho". peshita! mahu detema: rofe kim leh tefe, ka mashma lan.
Rofe omer tzarich, vechole omer eno tzarich — shomin larofe. may tama — tuneba hu denaket leh.
Tenan: chole — maachilin oto al pi bekiin. al pi bekiin — in, al pi atzmo — la! al pi bekiin — in, al pi baki echad — la!
Hacha bemay askinan, deamar la tzerichna. velispo leh al pi baki! la tzericha, deikka acharina bahadeh deamar la tzerich — maachilin oto al pi bekiin.

Peshita, sefek nefashot hu, usefek nefashot lehakel! la tzericha, deikka tere acharine bahadeh deamri la tzerich. veaf al gav deamar rav safra: tere kima umea kitre, hane mille leinyan edut, aval leinyan umedana — batar deot azlinan.
Vehane mille leinyan umedana demamona, aval hacha sefek nefashot hu.

Veha middekatane sefa: veim en sham bekiin maachilin oto al pi atzmo, mikkelal deresha deamar tzarich! chassore michassera vehachi katane: bamme devarim amurim — deamar lo tzarich ani, aval amar tzarich ani, en sham bekiin tere ella chad deamar lo tzarich — maachilin oto al pi atzmo.
Mar bar rav ashe amar: kol hecha deamar tzarich ani, afillu ikka mea deamri lo tzarich ledideh shaminan — shenneemar: "lev yodea morat nafsho".

Tenan: im en sham bekiin — maachilin oto al pi atzmo. tama delekka bekiin, ha ikka bekiin la! hachi kaamar: bamme devarim amurim — deamar "lo tzarich ani", aval amar "tzarich ani", en sham bekiin kelal — maachilin oto al pi atzmo, shenneemar: "lev yodea morat nafsho".
Mishna mi sheachazo bulemos — maachilin oto afillu devarim temeim, ad sheyyeoru enav. mi shenneshacho kelev shote — en maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello. verabbi matya ben charash mattir.
Veod amar rabbi matya ben charash: hachoshesh bigrono — metilin lo sam betoch piv beshabbat, mippene shehu sefek nefashot, vechol sefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat.
Mi shennafla alav mappolet, safek hu sham safek eno sham, safek chay safek met, safek goy safek yisrael, mefakkechin alav et haggal. metzauhu chay — mefakkechin, veim met — yenichuhu.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: minnayin hayu yodin sheheiru enav — mishsheyyavchin ben tov lara. amar abbaye: uvetama.
Tanu rabbanan: mi sheachazo bulemos — maachilin oto hakkal hakkal, tevel unevela — maachilin oto nevela. tevel usheviit — sheviit.

Tevel uteruma — tannae hi. detanya: maachilin oto tevel veen maachilin oto teruma. ben tema omer: teruma velo tevel. amar rabba: hecha deefshar bechullin, dechulle alma la peligi dimtakkeninan leh umaspinan leh.
Ki peligi bidla efshar bechullin. mar savar tevel chamur, umar savar teruma chamura. mar savar tevel chamur — aval teruma chazya lechohen. umar savar teruma chamura, aval tevel efshar letakkoneh.
b: Efshar bechullin — peshita? la tzericha, beshabbat.
Beshabbat name, peshita — tiltul midderabbanan hu! hacha bemay askinan — beatzitz sheeno nakuv, derabbanan.
Mar savar tevel chamur, umar savar teruma chamura.

Lema tannae hi. detanya: mi shenneshacho nachash — korin lo rofe mimmakom lemakom, umekarin lo et hattarnegolet, vegozzin lo et hakkereshin, umaachilin oto, veen tzarich leasser, divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lo yochal ad sheyyeasser.
Nema rabbi elazar berabbi shimon hi, vela rabbi!

Afillu tema rabbi, ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam — ella leinyan masar yarak derabbanan, aval bemasar dagan detevel deorayyta hu, afillu rabbi mode, dei sharet leh beatzitz sheeno nakuv — ate lemechal beatzitz shehu nakuv.

Tanu rabbanan mi: sheachazo bulemus — maachilin oto devash vechol mine metika, shehaddevash vechol mine metika meirin meor enav shel adam. veaf al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar: "reu na ki oru enay ki taamti meat devash hazze".
Umay: "af al pi sheen reaya laddavar"! dehatam lav bulemus achze.

Amar abbaye: lo shanu, ella leachar achila, aval kodem achila migrar garer, dichtiv: "vayyimtzeu ish mitzri bassade vayyikchu oto el david vayyittenu lo lechem vayyochal vayyashkuhu mayim. vayyittenu lo felach devela ushene tzimmukim vayyochal vattashov rucho elav ki lo achal lechem velo shata mayim shelosha yamim ushelosha lelot".

Amar rav nachman amar shemuel: mi sheachazo bulemus — maachilin oto alya bidvash. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: af solet nekiyya bidvash. rav pappa amar: afillu kimcha disare beduvesha. amar rabbi yochanan: paam achat achazani bulemus veratzti lemizrachah shel teena, vekiyyaymti beatzmi: "hachochma techayye vealeha". detane rav yosef: harotze litom taam teena — yifne lemizrachah, shenneemar: "umimmeged tevuot shamesh".

Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose havo ka azli beorcha. achze bulemus lerabbi yehuda, kappecheh leroe achleh lerifta. amar leh rabbi yose: kippachta et haroe. ki meto lemata, achze bulemus lerabbi yose. ahderuhu belage vetzae, amar leh rabbi yehuda: ani kippachti et haroe, veatta kippachta et hair kullah.

Vetu: rabbi meir verabbi yehuda verabbi yose havo ka azli beorcha, rabbi meir hava dayek bishma, rabbi yehuda verabbi yose la havo dayyki bishma. ki meto lehahu ducheta, beo ushepiza. yehavu lehu. amaru leh: ma shemach? amar lehu: "kidor". amar: shema minna adam rasha hu, shenneemar: "ki dor tahpuchot hemma". rabbi yehuda verabbi yose ashlimu leh kisayyhu. rabbi meir la ashlem leh kiseh, azal otveh be kivreh daavu.

Itchazi leh bechelmeh: ta shekel kisa demannach aresha dehahu gavra. limchar amar lehu: hachi itchazi li bechelmay. amri leh: chelma deve shimshe let behu mammasha, azal rabbi meir venatreh kulle yoma veayyeytye.

Limchar amaru leh: hav lan kisan. amar lehu: lo hayu devarim meolam. amar lehu rabbi meir: ammay la dayykitu bishma? amaru leh: ammay la amart lan mar? amar lehu: emar daamari ana chashasha, achzoke mi amari?
Mashchuhu veayyeyluhu lachanuta, chazo telafche assefameh, azalu vihavu simana lidvethu veshaklu lechisayyhu veayyto. azal ihu vekatleh leitteteh.
Hayeynu (ditnan): mayim rishonim heechilu besar chazir. mayim acharonim hargu et hannefesh.

Ulevassof havo dayyki bishma. ki meto lehahu beta dishmeh "bala", la ayaylu legabbeh. amri: shema minna rasha hu. dichtiv: "vaomar labbala niufim", (kemo: "achare veloti hayta li edna", kelomar: zakna beniufim).

Mi shenneshacho kelev shote vechulei. tanu rabbanan, chamishsha devarim neemru bechelev shote: piv patuach, veriro notef, veoznav seruchot, uzenavo munnach al yarchotav, umehallech betzidde derachim. veyesh omrim: af noveach veen kolo nishma. mimmay have? rav amar: nashim kashfaniyyot mesachakot bo, ushemuel amar: ruach raa shora alav.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu

a: Lemikteleh bedavar hannizrak.

Tanya kevoteh dishmuel. keshehorgin oto — en horgin oto ella bedavar hannizrak. dechayef beh — mistakkan, denachet leh — mayet. dechayef beh — mistakkan: may takkanteh? nishallach maneh venirhayt. rav huna bereh derav yehoshua chaf beh chad minnayyhu beshuka, shallechinhu lemaneh verahet. amar: kiyyaymti beatzmi "hachochma techayye vealeha".

Denachet leh mayet: may takkanteh? amar abbaye: nete mashka deappa dichra venichtov aleh: ana pelanya bar pelanita ammashka deappa dichra katevna alach: "kanti kanti keleros". veamri la: "kandi kandi keloros, yah yah Adonai tzevaot amen amen sela". venishlechinhu lemaneh velikberinhu be kivre ad teresar yarche shatta, venappekinhu veniklinhu betannura unevadderinhu lekitmeh apparashat derachim. vehanach teresar yarche shatta, ki shate mayya — la lishte ella beguveta dinchasha, dilma chaze bavua desheda velistakkan. ki ha deabba bar marta hu abba bar minyome, avada leh immeh guveta dedahava.

Veod amar rabbi matya: rabbi yochanan chash betzafdina. azal gabba dehahi matronita, avada leh milleta chamsha umaale shabbeta. amar la: beshabbat may? amara leh: la tzerichat. i mitzterichna may? amara leh: ishteva li dela megallet, ishteva: lelaha deyisrael la megallena. nefak darsha befirka.
Veha ishteva la! lelaha deyisrael la megallena. ha leammo yisrael — megallena. veha ikka chillul hashshem! dimgalle la meikkara.

May avada leh? amar rav acha bereh derav amme: me seor, shemen zayit, vamelach. rav yemar amar: seor gufeh, shemen zayit, vamelach. rav ashe amar: mishcha degadpa daavoza. amar abbaye: ana avadi lechullehu vela ittassay, ad daamar li hahu tayyaya: ayyti kashyayta dezeta dela melo tilta, ukelinhu benura ammara chadta, veadbek bechakke dare. avadi hachi veittassay.

Mimmay hava? mechammime chammime dechitte, umishshiyyure kasa deharsana. umay simaneh — kad rame midde bechakkeh veate dema mibbe dare. rabbi yochanan ki chash betzafdina, avad hachi beshabbeta veittassi. verabbi yochanan hechi aved hachi? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: shane tzafdina hoil umatchil bappe, vegomer bivne meayim.
Amar leh rav chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: keman — kerabbi matya ben charash, deamar: hachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat. amar leh: sheani omer bezo, velo beacheret.

Lema mesayyay leh: mi sheachazo yerakon — maachilin oto besar chamor, mi shenneshacho kelev shote — maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello, vehachoshesh befiv — metilin lo sam beshabbat, divre rabbi matya ben charash. vachachamim omrim: beellu en bahem mishshum refua. "beellu" lemaote may? may lav, lemaote sam?

La, lemaote: makkizin dam lisronche. hachi name mistabbera. detanya: shelosha devarim amar rabbi yishmael berabbi yose sheshshama mishshum rabbi matya ben charash: makkizin dam lisronche beshabbat, umi shenneshacho kelev shote — maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello, vehachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat.
Vachachamim omrim: beellu en bahen mishshum refua. "beellu" lemaote may? may lav, attarte batrayayta ulemaote deresha! la: attarte deresha kammayayta, ulemaote desefa.
b: Ta shema, detane rabba bar shemuel: ubbara shehericha — maachilin otah ad shettashuv nafshah, umi shenneshacho kelev shote — maachilin oto mechatzar kaved shello, vehachoshesh befiv — metilin lo sam beshabbat, divre rabbi elazar berabbi yose, sheamar mishshum rabbi matya ben charash. vachachamim omrim: bazo velo beacheret. "bezo" aheyay? illema aubbara, peshita! ubbara mi ikka leman deamar dela? ella lav — assam. shema minna.

Rav ashe amar: matnitin name dayka — veod amar rabbi matya ben charash: hachoshesh befiv metilin lo sam beshabbat, vela peligi rabbanan aleh. veim ita difligi rabbanan aleh, liarvinhu velitninhu, velippalgu rabbanan besefa. shema minna.
Mippene shessefek nefashot hu vechulei. lema li tu lememar: "vechol sefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat"? amar rav yehuda amar rav: lo safek shabbat zo bilvad amru, ella afillu safek shabbat acheret.
Hechi dame? kegon deamdu litmanya yome, veyoma kamma shabbeta. mahu detema: liakkav ad leureta ki hechi dela nechul aleh tere shabbata, ka mashma lan.

Tanya name hachi: mechammin chammin lachole beshabbat, ben lehashekoto ben lehaveroto. velo shabbat zo bilvad amru, ella leshabbat acheret. veen omrim: namtin lo shemma yavri, ella mechammin lo miyyad, mippene shessefek nefashot doche et hashshabbat. velo safek shabbat zo, ella afillu safek shabbat acheret.

Veen osin devarim hallalu, lo al yede goyim, velo al yede kutiyyim, ella al yede gedole yisrael. veen omrin yeasu devarim hallalu, lo al pi nashim, velo al pi kutiyyim, aval mitztarfin ledaat acheret.

Tanu rabbanan: mefakkechin pikkuach nefesh beshabbat, vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach, veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din. ha ketzad? raa tinok shennafal layyam — pores metzuda umaalehu, vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach, veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din. veaf al gav deka tzayed kevore. raa tinok shennafal levor — oker chuleya umaalehu, vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach, veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din. af al gav dimtakken darga.

Raa shenninala delet bifne tinok — shovrah umotzio, vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach, veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din. veaf al gav deka mikkavven lemitbar beshife. mechabbin umafsikin mippene haddeleka beshabbat, vehazzariz hare ze meshubbach, veen tzarich littol reshut mibbet din. veaf al gav deka memakkech makkoche.
Utzericha: dei ashmeinan yam — mishshum deaddehachi vehachi azel leh, aval bor, deka yatev — ema la, tzericha.
Vei ashmeinan bor — mishshum deka mibbeit, aval ninala delet, efshar deyatev behay gisa umeshabbesh leh beamgoze. tzericha.
Mechabbin umafsikin. lema li? daafillu lechatzer acheret.

Amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo halchu befikkuach nefesh achar harov. hechi dame? i nema deikka tisha yisrael vegoy echad benayyhu — rubba yisrael ninhu, (ella) palga ufalga, sefek nefashot lehakel.
Ella deikka tisha goyim veyisrael echad. ha name peshita — dehave leh kavua, vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame!
La tzericha, difrush lechatzer acheret, mahu detema: kol defaresh — merubba paresh, ka mashma lan dela halchu befikkuach nefesh achar harov.
Ini?! vehaamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: tisha goyim veyisrael echad beotah chatzer — mefakkechin, bechatzer acheret — en mefakkechin! la kashya: ha difrush kullehu, ha difrush miktzatayyhu.
Umi amar shemuel hachi? vehatnan: matza vah tinok mushelach, im rov goyim — goy, veim rov yisrael — yisrael, mechetza al mechetza — yisrael. veamar rav: lo shanu ella lehacheyoto, aval leyaychaso lo.

a: Ushemuel amar lefakkeach alav et haggal. ki ittemar dishmuel — aresha ittemar: im rov goyim — goy, amar shemuel: uleinyan pikkuach nefesh eno ken.
Im rov goyim — goy, lemay hilcheta? amar rav pappa: lehaachilo nevelot. im rov yisrael — yisrael, lemay hilcheta? lehachezir lo avedato.
Mechetza al mechetza — yisrael, lemay hilcheta? amar resh lakish: linzakin. hechi dame? i nema denagcheh tora didan letora dideh — nayyte reaya venishkol!
La tzericha, denagcheh tora dideh letora didan, palga — yahev leh, iddach palga — nema leh: ayyti reaya delav yisrael ana ushekol.
Mi shennafla alav mappolet vechulei. may kaamar?

La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya safek hu sham safek eno sham, dei iteh chay — hu dimfakkechin, ella afillu safek chay safek met — mefakkechin. vela mibbaya safek chay safek met, deyisrael, ella afillu safek goy safek yisrael — mefakkechin.
Metzauhu chay — mefakkechin. metzauhu chay, peshita! la tzericha, daafillu lechayye shaa.

Veim met yannichuhu. ha name peshita? la tzericha, lerabbi yehuda ben lakish. detanya: en matztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka, amar rabbi yehuda ben lakish: shamati shemmatztzilin et hammet mippene haddeleka. vaafillu rabbi yehuda ben lakish la kaamar ella mittoch sheadam bahul al meto, i la sharet leh — ate lechabboye. aval hacha, i la sharet leh — may it leh lemebad?
Tanu rabbanan: ad hechan hu bodek? ad chotmo. veyesh omrim: ad libbo. badak umatza elyonim metim, lo yomar: kevar metu hattachtonim. maase haya umatzu elyonim metim vetachtonim chayyim.

Nema hane tannae ki hane tannae. detanya: mehechan havvalad notzar — merosho, shenneemar: "mimmee immi atta gozi", veomer: "gozzi nizrech vehashelichi". abba shaul omer: mittibburo, umeshalleach shorashav elach veelach.

Afillu tema abba shaul, ad kan la ka amar abba shaul hatam ella leinyan yetzira, dechol midde mimmetziateh mittetzar, aval leinyan pikkuach nefesh — afillu abba shaul mode deikkar chayyuta beappeh hu, dichtiv: "kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav".
Amar rav pappa: machloket mimmatta lemala, aval mimmala lematta, kevan divdak leh ad chotmo — shuv eno tzarich, dichtiv: "kol asher nishmat ruach chayyim beappav".

Uchevar haya rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva verabbi elazar ben azarya mehallechin badderech, velevi hassaddar verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi elazar ben azarya mehallechin acharehen. nishala sheela zo bifnehem: minnayin lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat?

Naana rabbi yishmael veamar: "im bammachteret yimmatze haggannav" — uma ze, shessafek al mamon ba safek al nefashot ba, ushefichut damim metamme et haaretz, vegorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael, nittan lehatztzilo benafsho — kal vachomer lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat.

Naana rabbi akiva veamar: "vechi yazid ish al reehu vegomer meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut". "meim mizbechi" — velo meal mizbechi. veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella lehamit,
b: Aval lehachayot — afillu meal mizbechi. uma ze, shessafek yesh mammash bidvarav safek en mammash bidvarav, vaavoda docha shabbat — kal vachomer lefikkuach nefesh sheddoche et hashshabbat. naana rabbi elazar veamar: uma mila shehi echad mimmatayim vearbaim ushemona evarim shebbaadam docha et hashshabbat — kal vachomer lechol gufo sheddoche et hashshabbat.

Rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: "et shabbetotay tishmoru", yachol lakkol — talmud lomar: "ach" chalak. rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer: "ki kodesh hi lachem", hi mesura beyedchem velo attem mesurim beyadah.

Rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: "veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat", amra tora: challel alav shabbat achat kede sheyyishmor shabbatot harebe. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: i havay hatam, hava amena didi adifa middidhu: "vechay bahem" — velo sheyyamut bahem.

Amar rava: lechullehu it lehu pircha, bar middishmuel delet leh pircha. derabbi yishmael — dilma kidrava. deamar rava: may tama demachteret? chazaka, en adam maamid atzmo al mamono. vehay midda yada dekae leappeh, veamar i kae leappay — katelna leh, vehattora amra: ba lehorgecha — hashekem lehorgo. veashkechan vadday, safek menalan?
Derabbi akiva name — dilma kidabbaye. deamar abbaye: masrinan leh zuga derabbanan leda im mammash bidvarav. veashkechan vadday, safek mena lan?
Vechullehu ashkechan vadday, safek mena lan? vedishmuel, vadday let leh pircha. amar ravina veittema rav nachman bar yitzchak: tava chada pilpalta charifa mimmela tzanna dekare.

Mishna chattat veasham vadday — mechapperin. mita veyom hakkippurim — mechapperin im hatteshuva. teshuva — mechapperet al averot kallot: al ase, veal lo taase. veal hachamurot hu tole, ad sheyyavo yom hakkippurim vichapper. haomer: echeta veashuv, echeta veashuv — en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. echeta veyom hakkippurim mechapper — en yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lammakom — yom hakkippurim mechapper, averot shebben adam lachavero — en yom hakkippurim mechapper, ad sheyyeratztze et chavero.

Darash rabbi elazar ben azarya: "mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". averot shebben adam lammakom — yom hakkippurim mechapper. averot shebben adam lachavero — en yom hakkippurim mechapper ad sheyyeratztze et chavero. amar rabbi akiva: ashrechem yisrael! lifne mi attem mittaharin, mi metaher etchem? avichem shebbashshamayim, shenneemar: "vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim utehartem", veomer: "mikve yisrael (Adonai)", ma mikve metaher et hattemeim — af hakkadosh baruch hu metaher et yisrael.
Gemara asham vadday — in, asham taluy — la. veha kappara ketiva beh? hanach mechapperi kappara gemura, asham taluy eno mechapper kappara gemura.

I name: hanach en acher mechapper kapparatan, asham taluy acher mechapper kapparatan, ditnan: chayyayve chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim — chayyayvin, ashamot teluyin — peturin.

Mita veyom hakkippurim mechapperin im hatteshuva. im hatteshuva — in, bifne atzman — la. nema dela kerabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: al kol averot shebbattora, ben asa teshuva ben lo asa teshuva — yom hakkippurim mechapper, chutz (mipporek ol), umegalle panim battora, umefer berit basar, sheim asa teshuva — yom hakkippurim mechapper, veim lo asa teshuva — en yom hakkippurim mechapper.
Afillu tema rabbi: teshuva baaya yom hakkippurim, yom hakkippurim la baaya teshuva.
Teshuva mechapperet al averot kallot: al ase veal lo taase. hasheta al lo taase mechapperet, al ase mibbaya? amar rav yehuda, hachi kaamar: al ase, veal lo taase shennittak laase.
Veal lo taase gamur la? ureminhu, ellu hen kallot: ase velo taase,

a: Chutz millo tissa"! "lo tissa" vechol dedame leh.
Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: kol shehu millo tissa" ulematta — teshuva mechapperet, millo tissa" ulemala — teshuva tola veyom hakkippurim mechapper. "lo tissa" vechol dedame leh.

Ta shema: lefi shenneemar bechorev teshuva "venakke", yachol af "lo tissa" immahen — talmud lomar: "lo yenakke". yachol af shear chayyayve lavin ken — talmud lomar: "et shemo", shemo hu deeno menakke, aval menakke shear chayyayve lavin.
Tannae hi, detanya: al ma teshuva mechapperet — al ase veal lo taase shennittak laase, veal ma teshuva tola veyom hakkippurim mechapper — al karetot veal mitot bet din, veal lo taase gamur.

Amar mar: lefi shenneemar bechorev "venakke". mena lan? detanya, rabbi elazar omer: i efshar lomar "nakke", shekkevar neemar "lo yenakke", vei efshar lomar "lo yenakke", shekkevar neemar "nakke". ha ketzad? menakke hu leshavin, veeno menakke lesheenan shavin.
Shaal rabbi matya ben charash et rabbi elazar ben azarya beromi: shamata arbaa chilluke chappara shehaya rabbi yishmael doresh? amar: shelosha hen, uteshuva im kol echad veechad.

Avar al ase veshav — eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo, shenneemar: "shuvu banim shovavim". avar al lo taase veasa teshuva — teshuva tola, veyom hakkippurim mechapper. shenneemar: "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem mikkol chattotechem". avar al karetot umitot bet din veasa teshuva — teshuva veyom hakkippurim tolin, veyissurin memarkin. shenneemar: "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam".

Aval mi sheyyesh chillul hashshem beyado — en lo koach bitshuva litlot velo beyom hakkippurim lechapper velo beyissurin lemarek, ella kullan tolin, umita memareket, shenneemar: "venigla veoznay Adonai tzevaot im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun".
Hechi dame chillul hashshem? amar rav: kegon ana, i shakelna bisra mittabbacha vela yahevna deme lealtar. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella beatra dela tavi, aval beatra detavi — let lan ba.
Amar ravina: umata machseya atra detavi hu. abbaye kidshakel bisra mittere shuttafe, yahev zuza lehay vezuza lehay, vahadar mekarev lehu gabbe hadade veaved chushebana.

Rabbi yochanan amar: kegon ana dimsaggena arba ammot bela tora uvela tefillin. yitzchak deve rabbi yannay amar: kol shechaverav mitbayyeyshin mechamat shemuato (hayeynu chillul hashshem). amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: kegon deka amri inashe: shera leh mareh liflanya.

Abbaye amar, kidtanya: "veahavta et Adonai elohecha", sheyyehe shem shamayim mitahev al yadcha. sheyyehe kore veshone umeshammesh talmide chachamim, vihe massao umattano benachat im habberiyyot, ma habberiyyot omrot alav — ashre aviv shellimmedo tora, ashre rabbo shellimmedo tora. oy lahem labberiyyot shello lamdu tora, peloni shellimmedo tora — reu kamma naim derachav, kamma metukkanim maasav. alav hakkatuv omer: "vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar".

Aval mi shekkore veshone umeshammesh talmide chachamim, veen massao umattano beemuna, veen dibburo benachat im habberiyyot, ma habberiyyot omrot alav — oy lo lifloni shellamad tora. oy lo leaviv shellimmedo tora, oy lo lerabbo shellimmedo tora. peloni shellamad tora — reu kamma mekulekalin maasav vechamma mechoarin derachav, vealav hakkatuv omer: "beemor lahem am Adonai elle umeartzo yatzau".
Amar rabbi chama (bar) chanina: gedola teshuva shemmevia rifut leolam, shenneemar: "erpa meshuvatam ohavem nedava".
Rabbi chama (bar) chanina rame, ketiv: "shuvu banim shovavim", demeikkara shovavim attem, uchetiv: "erpa meshuvotechem"! la kashya: kan meahava, kan miyyira.

Rav yehuda rame, ketiv: "shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem", uchetiv: "(hinne) anochi baalti vachem velakachti etchem echad meir ushenayim mimmishpacha"! la kashya: kan meahava o miyyira, kan al yede yissurin. amar rabbi levi: gedola teshuva shemmaggaat ad kisse hakkavod, shenneemar: "shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha".
b: Amar rabbi yochanan: gedola teshuva sheddocha et lo taase shebbattora, shenneemar: "lemor hen yeshallach ish et ishto vehalcha meitto vehayta leish acher hayashuv eleha od halo chanof techenaf haaretz hahi veat zanit reim rabbim veshov elay neum Adonai".
Amar rabbi yonatan: gedola teshuva (shemmekarevet) et haggeulla, shenneemar: "uva letziyyon goel uleshave fesha beyaakov", ma taam "uva letziyyon goel" — mishshum deshave fesha beyaakov".

Amar resh lakish: gedola teshuva shezzedonot naasot lo kishgagot, shenneemar: "shuva yisrael ad Adonai elohecha ki chashalta baavonecha", ha "avon" — mezid hu, veka kare leh michshol. ini?! vehaamar resh lakish: gedola teshuva shezzedonot naasot lo kizchiyyot, shenneemar: "uveshuv rasha merishato veasa mishpat utzedaka alehem (chayo) yichye"! la kashya: kan meahava, kan miyyira.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: gedola teshuva shemmaarechet shenotav shel adam, shenneemar: "uveshuv rasha merishato (chayo) yichye".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: amri bemareva mishshemeh derabba bar mari: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam: middat basar vadam, maknit et chavero bidvarim — safek mitpayyes hemennu, safek en mitpayyes hemennu. veim tomar mitpayyes hemennu — safek mitpayyes bidvarim, safek en mitpayyes bidvarim,

Aval hakkadosh baruch hu, adam over avera basseter — mitpayyes mimmennu bidvarim, shenneemar: "kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai". velo od, ella shemmachzik lo tova, shenneemar: "vekach tov". velo od ella shemmaale alav hakkatuv keillu hikriv parim, shenneemar: "uneshallema parim sefatenu". shemma tomar pare chova, talmud lomar: "erpa meshuvatam ohavem nedava".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: gedola teshuva, shebbishvil yachid sheasa teshuva — mochalin lechol haolam kullo, shenneemar: "erpa meshuvatam ohavem nedava ki shav appi mimmennu". "mehem" lo neemar, ella "mimmennu".
Hechi dame baal teshuva? amar rav yehuda: kegon shebbat leyado devar avera paam rishona usheniyya venitztzal hemenna. machve rav yehuda: beotah ishsha, beoto perek, beoto makom.

Amar rav yehuda, rav rame — ketiv: "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa", uchetiv: "mechasse feshaav lo yatzliach"! la kashya: ha bechet mefuresam, ha bechet sheeno mefuresam. rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav nachman: kan baaverot shebben adam lachavero, kan baaverot shebben adam lammakom.

Tanya, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: adam over avera paam rishona — mochalin lo, sheniyya — mochalin lo, shelishit — mochalin lo, reviit — en mochalin lo, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu", (veneemar:) "hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver".

May "veomer"? vechi tema: hane mille betzibbur, aval beyachid — la, ta shema: "hen kol elle yifal el paamayim shalosh im gaver". (mikkan veelach en mochalin lo, shenneemar: "al shelosha pishe yisrael veal arbaa lo ashivennu".)

Tanu rabbanan: averot shehitvadda alehen yom hakkippurim ze, lo yitvadde alehen yom hakkippurim acher. veim shana bahen — tzarich lehitvaddot yom hakkippurim acher. veim lo shana bahen, vechazar vehitvadda — alehen alav hakkatuv omer: "kechelev shav al kio kesil shone beivvalto".

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kol shekken shehu meshubbach, shenneemar: "ki feshaay ani eda vechattati negdi tamid". ella ma ani mekayyem "kechelev shav al kio vegomer" — kidrav huna. deamar rav huna, kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah — huttera lo. huttera lo salka datach?! ella ema: naaset lo kehetter.

Vetzarich lifrot et hachet, shenneemar: "anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav", divre rabbi yehuda ben bava. rabbi akiva omer: "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa". ella mahu sheamar moshe: "vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav"? kidrabbi yannay. deamar rabbi yannay: amar moshe lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! kesef vezahav shehirbeta lahem leyisrael ad sheamru day — garam lahem sheyyaasu elohe zahav.

Shene parnasim tovim amdu lahem leyisrael: moshe vedavid. moshe amar: yikkatev surechani, shenneemar: "yaan lo heemantem bi lehakedisheni", david amar: al yikkatev surechani. shenneemar: "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa".

Mashal demoshe vedavid lema haddavar dome? lishte nashim shellaku bevet din, achat kilkela, veachat achla pagge sheviit. amra lahen otah sheachla pagge sheviit: bevakkasha mikkem, hodiu al ma hi loka, shello yomru: al ma shezzo loka — zo loka. heviu pagge sheviit vetalu betzavvarah, vehayu machrizin lefaneha veomrin: al iske sheviit hi loka.

Mefarsemin et hachanefin mippene chillul hashshem, shenneemar: "uveshuv tzaddik mitztzidko veasa avel venatatti michshol lefanav". teshuvat hammuchelatin meakkevet happureanut, veaf al pi shennechtam alav gezar din shel pureanut.

Shalvat reshaim sofah takkala, veharshut mekabberet et bealeha, arom nichnas lah vearom yetze mimmenna, ulevay shettehe yetzia kevia. rav ki hava nafek lemedan dina amar hachi: bitzvu nafsheh liktala nafek, utzevu beteh let hu aved, verekan leveteh azel, ulevay shettehe bia kitzia.
Rava ki hava nafek ledina amar hachi:

a: Bitzvu nafsheh liktala nafek, utzevu beteh let hu aved, verekan leveteh azel, ulevay shettehe bia kitzia. vechi have chaze ambuha abbatreh, amar: "im yaale lashshamayim sio verosho laav yaggia. kegelalo lanetzach yoved roav yomru ayyo". rav zutera, ki havo mechattefi leh beshabbeta derigla, hava amar: "ki lo leolam chosen veim nezer ledor vador".

"Seet pene rasha lo tov" — lo tov lahem larshaim shennosin lahem panim baolam hazze. lo tov lo leachav shennasu lo panim baolam hazze, shenneemar: "yaan ki nichna (achav millefanay) lo avi haraa beyamav".

"Lehattot tzaddik bammishpat" — tov lahem latztzaddikim sheen nosin lahem panim baolam hazze. tov lo lemoshe shello nasu lo panim baolam hazze, shenneemar: "yaan lo heemantem bi lehakedisheni", ha illu heemantem bi — adayin lo higgia zemannam lippater min haolam.

Ashrehem latztzaddikim, lo dayyayn shehen zochin, ella shemmezakkin livnehem velivne venehem ad sof kol haddorot. shekkamma banim hayu lo leaharon sheruyin lissaref kenadav vaavihu, shenneemar: "hannotarim", ella sheamad lahem zechut avihem.

Oy lahem larshaim, lo dayyayn shemmechayyeyvin atzman, ella shemmechayyeyvin livnehem velivne venehem ad sof kol haddorot. harebe banim hayu lo lichnaan sheruyin lissamech ketavi avdo shel rabban gamliel, ella shechovat avihem garma lahen.

Kol hamezakke et harabbim — en chet ba al yado, vechol hammachti et harabbim — kimat en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. kol hamezakke et harabbim — en chet ba al yado, may tama? kede shello yehe hu begehinnam vetalmidav began eden, shenneemar: "ki lo taazov nafshi lishol lo titten chasidcha lirot shachat". vechol hammachti et harabbim — en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva, shello yehe hu began eden vetalmidav begehinnam, shenneemar: "adam ashuk bedam nafesh ad bor yanus al yitmechu vo".

Haomer echeta veashuv echeta veashuv. lema li lememar "echeta veashuv, echeta veashuv" tere zimne? kidrav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: kevan sheavar adam avera veshana bah — huttera lo. huttera lo salka datach?! ella: naaset lo kehetter.

Echeta veyom hakkippurim mechapper — en yom hakkippurim mechapper. lema matnitin dela kerabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: al kol averot shebbattora, ben asa teshuva ben lo asa teshuva — yom hakkippurim mechapper! afillu tema rabbi, aggav shane.

Averot shebben adam lammakom vechulei. rame leh rav yosef bar chavu lerabbi avahu: averot shebben adam lachavero en yom hakkippurim mechapper? veha ketiv: "im yecheta ish leish ufillo elohim"! man elohim — dayyayna.

I hachi, ema sefa: "veim laAdonai yecheta ish mi yitpallel lo"! hachi kaamar: "im yecheta ish leish ufillo elohim" — yimchol lo. "veim laAdonai yecheta ish mi yitpallel baado" — teshuva umaasim tovim.

Amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hammaknit et chavero, afillu bidvarim — tzarich lefayyeyso, shenneemar: "beni im aravta lereecha takata lazzar kappecha nokashta veimre ficha ase zot efo beni vehinnatzel ki vata vechaf reecha lech hitrappes urehav reecha". im mamon yesh beyadcha — hatter lo pissat yad, veim lav — harebe alav reim.
(Veamar) rav chisda: vetzarich lefayyeyso beshalosh shurot shel shelosha bene adam, shenneemar: "yashor al anashim vayyomer chatati veyashar heeveti velo shava li".

(Veamar) rabbi yose bar chanina: kol hamevakkesh matu mechavero, al yevakkesh mimmennu yoter mishshalosh peamim, shenneemar: "anna sa na veatta sa na". veim met — mevi asara bene adam umaamidan al kivro, veomer: chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael velifloni shechavalti bo.

Rabbi yirmeya hava leh milleta lerabbi abba bahadeh, azal ittiv addashsha derabbi abba bahade deshadya ammeteh mayya, meta zarzife demayya aresha. amar: asauni keashpa. kera annafsheh: "meashpot yarim evyon". shema rabbi abba unefek leappeh, amar leh: hasheta tzerichna lemippak addatach, dichtiv: "lech hitrappes urehav reecha".
Rabbi zera ki hava leh milleta bahade inish, hava chalef vetane lekammeh umamtze leh, ki hechi denete venippok leh middateh.

Rav hava leh milleta bahade hahu tabbacha, la ata lekammeh. bemaale yoma dechippure amar ihu: ezil ana lefayyose leh. pega beh rav huna, amar leh: lehecha ka azel mar, amar leh: lefayyose liflanya. amar: azel abba lemiktal nafsha. azal vekam illaveh. hava yatev veka fale resha, dalli eneh vechazyeh, amar leh: abba at? zil, let li milleta bahadach. bahade deka fale resha, ishtemit garma umachyeh bekoeh vekatleh.
Rav hava pasek sidra kammeh derabbi. ayayl
b: Ata rabbi chiyyay — hadar leresha. ayayl bar kappara — hadar leresha. ata rabbi shimon berabbi — hadar leresha. ata rabbi chanina (bar) chama, amar: kulle hay nehdar venezil? la hadar. ikkefid rabbi chanina, azal rav legabbeh telesar maale yome dechippure vela ippayyays.

Vehechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yose bar chanina: kol hamevakkesh matu mechavero al yevakkesh mimmennu yoter mishshalosh peamim! rav shane. verabbi chanina, hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rava: kol hammaavir al middotav — maavirin lo al kol peshaav!

Ella: rabbi chanina chelma chaze leh lerav dezakfuhu bedikla, ugemiri dechol dezakfuhu bedikla — resha have. amar: shema minna bae lemebad reshuta vela ippayyays, ki hechi delezil veligmar orayyta bevavel.

Tanu rabbanan: mitzvat vidduy erev yom hakkippurim im chashecha. aval amru chachamim: yitvadde kodem sheyyochal veyishte, shemma tittaref dato bisuda. veaf al pi shehitvadda kodem sheachal veshata — mitvadde leachar sheyyochal veyishte, shemma era devar kalkala basseuda. veaf al pi shehitvadda arvit — yitvadde shacharit. shacharit — yitvadde bemusaf, bemusaf — yitvadde bemincha, bemincha — yitvadde binila.

Vehechan omro? yachid achar tefillato, usheliach tzibbur omro baemtza. may amar? amar rav: "atta yodea raze olam". ushemuel amar: "mimmaamakke hallev". velevi amar: "uvetoratcha katuv lemor". rabbi yochanan amar: "ribbon haolamim".

Rabbi yehuda amar: "ki avonotenu rabbu millimnot vechattotenu atzmu missapper". rav hamenuna amar: "elohay, ad shello notzarti eni keday. achshav shennotzarti, keillu lo notzarti. afar ani bechayyay, kal vachomer bemitati. hare ani lefanecha kichli male busha uchelimma. yehi ratzon millefanecha shello echeta, uma shechatati — merok berachamecha, aval lo al yede yissurin". vehayeynu vidduya derava kulla shatta, uderav hamenuna zuta beyoma dechippure.

Amar mar zutera: la amaran, ella dela amar: "aval anachnu chatanu", aval amar: "aval anachnu chatanu" — tu la tzerich. deamar bar hamedude: hava kaemna kammeh dishmuel, vahava yatev, vechi meta shelicha detzibbura veamar: "aval anachnu chatanu", kam mekam, amar: shema minna ikkar vidduy hay hu.

Tenan hatam: bishlosha perakim bashshana kohanim nosin et kappehen arbaa peamim bayyom: beshacharit, bemusaf, bemincha, uvinilat shearim. veellu hen shelosha perakim: betaaniyyot, uvemaamadot, uveyom hakkippurim.

May neilat shearim? rav amar: tzelota yattirta. ushemuel amar: "ma anu me chayyenu". metivi: or yom hakkippurim mitpallel sheva umitvadde, beshacharit mitpallel sheva umitvadde, bemusaf mitpallel sheva umitvadde, bemincha mitpallel sheva umitvadde, binila mitpallel sheva umitvadde!

Tannae hi, detanya: yom hakkippurim im chashecha mitpallel sheva umitvadde, vechotem bevidduy — divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: mitpallel sheva, veim ratza lachtom bevidduy — chotem. teyuveta dishmuel teyuveta.
Ulla bar rav nechet kammeh derava. petach beatta bechartanu" vesayyem bema anu me chayyenu", veshabbecheh. rav huna bereh derav natan amar: veyachid omrah achar tefillato.
Amar rav: tefillat neila poteret et shel arvit. rav letameh, daamar: tzelota yattira hi, vechevan detzalli leh — tu la tzerich.
Umi amar rav hachi? vehaamar rav: halacha kedivre haomer tefillat arvit reshut! ledivre haomer chova kaamar.

Metivi: or yom hakkippurim mitpallel sheva umitvadde, shacharit sheva umitvadde, musaf sheva umitvadde, binila mitpallel sheva umitvadde, arvit mitpallel sheva meen shemone esre. rabbi chanina ben gamliel mishshum avotav: mitpallel shemone esre shelemot,

a: Mippene shetztzarich lomar havedala bechonen haddaat! tannae hi. detanya: kol chayyayve tevilot — tovlin kedarkan beyom hakkippurim. nidda veyoledet — tovlot kedarkan belele yom hakkippurim.
Baal keri — tovel veholech ad hammincha. rabbi yose omer: kol hayyom kullo.

Ureminhu: hazzav vehazzava hametzora vehametzoraat uvoel nidda uteme met — tovlin kedarkan beyom hakkippurim, nidda veyoledet — tovlot kedarkan belele yom hakkippurim. baal keri — tovel veholech kol hayyom kullo, rabbi yose omer: min hammincha ulemala en yachol litbol.
La kashya: ha detzalli tefillat neila, ha dela tzalli.
I detzalli, may tamayyhu derabbanan? ka savri rabbanan: tevila bizmannah mitzva.

Mikkelal derabbi yose savar lav mitzva. vehatanya: hare shehaya shem katuv al besaro — hare ze lo yirchatz velo yasuch velo yaamod bimkom hattinnofet. nizdammena lo tevilat mitzva — korech alav gemi veyored vetovel. rabbi yose omer: yored vetovel kedarko uvilvad shello yeshafshef.
Vekayyma lan devitvila bizmannah, mitzva peligi.
Hahi rabbi yose bar yehuda hi. detanya, rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: dayyah litvila shettehe baacharona.
Tanu rabbanan: haroe keri beyom hakkippurim — yored vetovel, velaerev yeshafshef. leerev? may dahava hava? ella ema: mibbaerev yeshafshef. (ka savar mitzva leshafshef.)
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: haroe keri beyom hakkippurim — avonotav mechulin lo. vehatanya: avonotav sedurin! may sedurin — sedurin limmachel.

Tana deve rabbi yishmael: haroe keri beyom hakkippurim — yidag kol hashshana kullah, veim alta lo shana — muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: teda, shekkol haolam kullo raev vehu savea. ki ata rav dimi amar: mappesh chayye sage umasge.
Hadaran alach yom hakkippurim uselika la massechet yoma
Sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma — pesula. verabbi yehuda machshir.
Vesheenah gevoha asara tefachim, vesheen lah (shelosha) defanot, veshechamatah merubba metzillatah — pesula.
Gemara tenan hatam: mavoy shehu gavoah meesrim amma — yemaet. rabbi yehuda omer: eno tzarich.
May shena gabbe sukka detane pesula, umay shena gabbe mavoy detane takkanta?
Sukka deorayyta, tane pesula. mavoy derabbanan, tane takkanta.
Veibbaet ema: bidorayyta name tane takkanta, mihu sukka dinfishi millata — pasek vetane pesula, mavoy dela nefish milleh — tane takkanta.
Mena hane mille?

Amar rabba, deamar kera: "lemaan yedu dorotechem ki vassukkot hoshavti et bene yisrael", ad esrim amma, adam yodea shehu dar bassukka, lemala meesrim amma — en adam yodea sheddar bassukka, mishshum dela shalta ba ena.
Rabbi zera amar mehacha: "vesukka tihye letzel yomam mechorev", ad esrim amma adam yoshev betzel sukka, lemala meesrim amma — en adam yoshev betzel sukka ella betzel defanot.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, haose sukkato beashterot karnayim, hachi name dela have sukka?
Amar leh: hatam, dal ashterot karnayim — ikka tzel sukka. hacha, dal defanot — lekka tzel sukka.

Verava amar, mehacha: "bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim". amra tora: kol shivat hayyamim tze middirat keva veshev bedirat aray. ad esrim amma adam ose dirato dirat aray, lemala meesrim amma — en adam ose dirato dirat aray ella dirat keva.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, asa mechitzot shel barzel vesikkech al gabban, hachi name dela have sukka?
Amar leh, hachi kaamena lach: ad esrim amma deadam ose dirato dirat aray, ki aved leh dirat keva, name nafek. lemala meesrim amma, deadam ose dirato dirat keva, ki aved leh dirat aray, name la nafek.
b: Kullehu kerabba la amri, hahu yedia ledorot hi.
Kerabbi zera name la amri, hahu limot hammashiach hu dichtiv.
Verabbi zera — im ken lema kera: "vechuppa tihye letzel yomam", umay "vesukka tihye letzel yomam" — shamat minna tarte.
Kerava name la amri, mishshum kusheya deabbaye.
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi yoshiyya amar rav: machloket besheen defanot maggiot lassechach, aval defanot maggiot lassechach — afillu lemala meesrim amma keshera. keman?
Kerabba, deamar mishshum dela shalta ba ena, vechevan didfanot maggiot lassechach, mishlat shalta ba ena.
Keman azla ha deamar rav huna amar rav: machloket besheen bah ella arba ammot al arba ammot, aval yesh bah yoter mearba ammot al arba ammot — afillu lemala meesrim amma keshera. keman?
Kerabbi zera, deamar: mishshum tzel hu, vechevan dirvicha — ikka tzel sukka.

Keman azla ha deamar rav chanan bar rabba amar rav: machloket besheenah machzeket ella kede rosho verubbo veshulechano, aval machzeket yoter mikkede rosho verubbo veshulechano — afillu lemala meesrim amma keshera. keman — dela kechad.
Bishlama derabbi yoshiyya peliga adderav huna verav chanan bar rabba, deinhu ka yahavi shiura bimshacha, veihu la ka yahev shiura bimshacha.
Ella rav huna verav chanan bar rabba, nema behechsher sukka kamippalgi, demar savar hechsher sukka bearba ammot, umar savar hechsher sukka bemachzeket rosho verubbo veshulechano?

La, dechulle alma hechsher sukka rosho verubbo veshulechano. vehacha beha kamippalgi: demar savar bemachzeket rosho verubbo veshulechano peligi, aval yoter merosho verubbo veshulechano — divre hakkol keshera,
Umar savar merosho verubbo veshulechano ad arba ammot peligi, aval yoter mearba ammot — divre hakkol keshera.
Metivi: sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma — pesula, verabbi yehuda machshir ad arbaim vachamishshim amma.

Amar rabbi yehuda: maase beheleni hammalka belod shehayta sukkatah gevoha meesrim amma, vehayu zekenim nichnasin veyotzin lesham velo amru lah davar. amru lo: mishsham reayay? ishsha hayta ufetura min hassukka. amar lahen: vahalo shiva banim havo lah, veod: kol maaseha lo asta ella al pi chachamim.
Lema li lemitne "veod kol maaseha lo asta ella al pi chachamim"?
Hachi kaamar lehu: ki tomru banim ketannim hayu, uketannim peturin min hassukka — kevan deshiva havo, i efshar dela have behu chad sheeno tzarich leimmo.
Vechi temru katan sheeno tzarich leimmo midderabbanan hu demichayyayv, veihi bidrabbanan la mashgecha, ta shema: veod, kol maaseha lo asta ella al pi chachamim.
Bishlama leman deamar besheen defanot maggiot lassechach machloket, darkah shel malka leshev besukka sheen defanot maggiot lassechach,

a: Mishshum avvera. ella leman deamar besukka ketanna machloket, vechi darkah shel malka leshev besukka ketanna? amar rabba bar rav adda: lo nitzrecha ella sukka haasuya kitoniyyot kitoniyyot.
Vechi darkah shel malka leshev besukka haasuya kitoniyyot kitoniyyot? amar rav ashe: lo nitzrecha ella lekitoniyyot shebbah.

Rabbanan savri: baneha besukka mealleya havo yatvi, veihi yatva bekitoniyyot mishshum tzeniuta, umishshum hachi la amri la davar. verabbi yehuda savar: baneha gabbah havo yatvi, vaafillu hachi la amri la davar.
Amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: halacha, tzericha shettehe machzeket rosho verubbo veshulechano. amar leh rabbi abba: keman, kevet shammay? amar leh: ella keman?!
Ikka deamri, amar rabbi abba: daamar lach manni? amar leh: bet shammay hi, vela tezuz minna.

Matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak: mimmay devet shammay uvet hillel besukka ketanna peligi? dilma besukka gedola peligi, uchegon deyatev appumma dimtulleta veshulechano betoch habbayit. devet shammay savri: gazrinan shemma yimmashech achar shulechano, uvet hillel savri: la gazrinan.
Vedayka name, dekatane: mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulechano betoch habbayit, bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin. veim ita, machzeket veenah machzeket mibbee leh.
Uvesukka ketanna la peligi? vehatanya: machzeket rosho verubbo veshulechano — keshera. rabbi omer: ad sheyyehe bah arba ammot al arba ammot.

Vetanya iddach, rabbi omer: kol sukka sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot — pesula. vachachamim omrim: afillu enah machzeket ella rosho verubbo — keshera. veillu shulechano la katane. kashyayn ahadade. ella lav, shema minna: ha bet shammay, ha bet hillel.
Amar mar zutera: matnitin name dayka, middekatane: "bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin", veim ita, "bet shammay omrim lo yatza, uvet hillel omrim yatza" mibbee leh.
Veella kashya "mi shehaya"!

Leolam betarte peligi: peligi besukka ketanna, ufeligi besukka gedola. vechassore michassera vehachi katane: mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulechano betoch habbayit, bet shammay omrim: lo yatza, uvet hillel omrim: yatza. vesheenah machzeket ella kede rosho verubbo bilvad, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin.
Man tena leha detanu rabbanan: bayit sheen bo arba ammot al arba ammot — patur min hammezuza, umin hammaake, veeno mittamme bingaim, veeno nechlat bevatte are choma,
Veen chozrin alav meorche hammilchama, veen mearvin bo, veen mishtattefin bo, veen mannichin bo eruv,
b: Veen osin oto ibbur ben shete ayayrot, veen haachin vehashshuttafin cholkin bo.

Lema rabbi hi vela rabbanan? afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam ella leinyan sukka — dedirat aray hi, aval legabbay bayit — dedirat keva hu, afillu rabbanan modu dei it beh arba ammot al arba ammot — dayyri beh inashe, vei la — la dayyri beh inashe.
Amar mar: patur min hammezuza, umin hammaake, veen mittamme bingaim, veeno nechlat bevatte are choma, veen chozrin alav meorche hammilchama. may tama? devayit" ketiv behu bechullehu.
Veen mearvin bo, veen mishtattefin bo, veen mannichin bo eruv. may tama — dela chaze ledira. eruve chatzerot — en mannichin bo, aval shittuf mannichin bo.
May tama — dela gara mechatzer shebbemavoy. ditnan: eruve chatzerot bechatzer, shittufe mavoy bammavoy.
Vehavenan ba, eruve chatzerot bechatzer? vehatnan: hannoten eruvo bevet shaar achsadra umirpeset — eno eruv, vehaddar sham eno oser.
Ella ema: eruve chatzerot bevayit shebbechatzer, veshittufe mevoot bechatzer shebbammavoy. vehay la gara mechatzer shebbemavoy.
Veen osin oto ibbur ben shete ayayrot. daafillu kevureganin la meshavvenan leh. may tama — bureganin chazu lemilletayyhu, vehay la chaze lemilleteh.
Veen haachin vehashshuttafin cholkin bo. tama delet beh arba ammot, ha it beh arba ammot — cholkin,
Vehatnan: en cholkin et hechatzer ad sheyyehe bah arba ammot laze vearba ammot laze!
Ella ema: en bo din chalukka kechatzer. deamar rav huna: chatzer lefi petacheha mitchalleket. verav chisda amar: noten lechol petach vafetach arba ammot, vehashshear cholkin oto beshave.
Dehane mille bayit, dilmeheve kae — yahavinan leh chatzer. hay, dilmistar kae — la yahavinan leh chatzer.
Hayta gevoha meesrim amma uva lemaatah becharim uchesatot — la have miut.

a: Veaf al gav devattelinhu [lechullehu], mishshum devatla dato etzel kol adam.
Teven uvittelo have miut, vechol shekken afar uvittelo.
Teven veen atid lefannoto, veafar setam — machloket rabbi yose verabbanan. ditnan: bayit shemmilleahu teven o tzerorot uvittelo — mevuttal.
Bittelo — in, lo bittelo — la. vetane ala, rabbi yose omer: teven veen atid lefannoto — hare hu keafar setam, uvatel. afar veatid lefannoto — hare hu kistam teven, vela batel.
Hayta gevoha meesrim amma vehutzin yordin betoch esrim amma, im tzillatam merubba mechamatam — keshera, veim lav — pesula.
Hayta gevoha asara tefachim, vehutzin yordin letoch asara, savar abbaye lememar im chamatam merubba mitztzillatam — keshera.
Amar leh rava: ha dira serucha hi, veen adam dar bedira serucha.
Hayta gevoha meesrim amma uvana bah itzteva keneged dofen haemtzai, al pene kullah veyesh bah hechsher sukka — keshera.
Umin hatztzad, im yesh missefat itzteva lakkotel arba ammot — pesula, pachot mearba ammot — keshera.
May ka mashma lan, deamrinan dofen akumma? tenena: bayit shennifchat vesikkech al gabbav, im yesh min hakkotel lassikkuch arba ammot — pesula, ha pachot mikkan keshera!
Mahu detema: hatam hu dechazya ledofen, aval hacha, dela chazya ledofen — ema la, ka mashma lan.
Hayta gevoha meesrim amma uvana itzteva beemtzaitah, im yesh missefat itzteva veladdofen arba ammot lechol ruach varuach — pesula, pachot mearba ammot — keshera.
May ka mashma lan, deamrinan dofen akumma? hayeynu hach!
Mahu detema: dofen akumma meruach achat — amrinan, aval kol ruach varuach — la, ka mashma lan.
Hayta pechuta measara tefachim, vechakak bah kede lehashelimah laasara, im yesh missefat chakak velakkotel shelosha tefachim — pesula.
b: Pachot mishshelosha tefachim — keshera.
May shena hatam, deamrat pachot mearba ammot, umay shena hacha, deamrat pachot mishshelosha tefachim?
Hatam, deiteh ledofen, pachot mearba ammot — saggi, hacha, leshauoye ledofen, pachot mishshelosha tefachim — in, i la — la.
Hayta gevoha meesrim amma, uvana bah ammud shehu gavoah asara tefachim, veyesh bo hechsher sukka — savar abbaye lememar, gud assek mechitzata.
Amar leh rava: baenan mechitzot hannikkarot, velekka.
Tanu rabbanan: naatz arbaa kunedesin vesikkech al gabban, rabbi yaakov machshir vachachamim poslin.

Amar rav huna: machloket al sefat haggag, derabbi yaakov savar: amrinan gud assek mechitzata, verabbanan savri: la amrinan gud assek mechitzata, aval baemtza haggag — divre hakkol pesula. verav nachman amar: beemtza haggag machloket.
Ibbaya lehu: beemtza haggag machloket, aval al sefat haggag divre hakkol keshera, o dilma, ben bazo uven bazo machloket? teku.
Metivi: naatz arbaa kunedesin baaretz vesikkech al gabban, rabbi yaakov machshir vachachamim poslin.
Veha eretz, dichemtza haggag dame, veka machshir rabbi yaakov! teyuveta derav huna, teyuveta.
Veod: baemtza hu difligi, aval al sefat haggag divre hakkol keshera! lema tehve teyuveteh derav huna betarte.
Amar lecha rav huna: peligi beemtza haggag, vehu haddin al sefat haggag. vehay dekamippalgi beemtza haggag, lehodiacha kocho derabbi yaakov, daafillu beemtza haggag name machshir.

Tanu rabbanan: naatz arbaa kunedesin baaretz vesikkech al gabban, rabbi yaakov omer: roin kol sheillu yechakku veyechalku, veyesh bahen tefach lechan vetefach lechan — niddonin mishshum deyomad, veim lav — en niddonin mishshum deyomad. shehaya rabbi yaakov omer: deyomde sukka tefach, vachachamim omrim: ad sheyyehu shetayim kehilchatan, ushelishit afillu tefach.
Vesheenah gevoha asara tefachim. menalan?
Ittemar, rav verabbi chanina verabbi yochanan verav chaviva matnu.
Bechulle seder moed, kol ki hay zuga — challofe rabbi yochanan umeayyeyli rabbi yonatan.
Aron tisha, vechapporet tefach — hare kan asara, uchetiv: "venoadti lecha sham vedibbarti ittecha meal hakkapporet",

a: Vetanya, rabbi yose omer: meolam lo yarda shechina lematta, velo alu moshe veeliyyahu lammarom, shenneemar: "hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam".
Velo yarda shechina lematta? vehachtiv: "vayyered Adonai al har sinay"! lemala measara tefachim. vehachtiv: "veamdu raglav bayyom hahu al har hazzetim"! lemala measara tefachim.

Velo alu moshe veeliyyahu lammarom? vehachtiv: "umoshe ala el haelohim"! lematta measara. vehachtiv: "vayyaal eliyyahu basara hashshamayim"! lematta measara. vehachtiv: "meachez pene kisse parshez alav anano", veamar rabbi tanchum: melammed shepperas shadday mizziv shechinato vaanano alav! lematta measara.
Mikkol makom "meachez pene kisse" ketiv! ishtarbove ishtarbav leh kisse ad asara, unekat beh.

Bishlama aron tisha, dichtiv: "veasu aron atze shittim ammatayim vachetzi orko veamma vachetzi rochbo veamma vachetzi komato". ella kapporet tefach, menalan? detane rabbi chanina: kol hakkelim sheasa moshe, natna bahen tora middat orkan umiddat rochban umiddat komatan. kapporet, middat orkah umiddat rochbah — natna, middat komatah — lo natna.
Tze ulemad mippachut shebbakkelim, shenneemar: "veasita lo misgeret tofach saviv", ma lehallan tefach, af kan tefach. venelaf mikkelim gufayyhu! tafasta merubbe — lo tafasta, tafasta muat — tafasta.

Venelaf mitztzitz, detanya: tzitz dome kemin tas shel zahav, verachav shete etzbaot umukkaf meozen leozen, vechatuv alav shete shitin: 'yod he millemala, vekodesh lamed millematta. veamar rabbi eliezer berabbi yose: ani reitiv beromi, vechatuv alav "kodesh laAdonai" beshita achat!
Danin keli mikkeli, veen danin keli mittachshit.
Venelaf mizzer. deamar mar: zer mashshehu! danin keli mikkeli, veen danin keli mehechsher keli. i hachi, misgeret name hechsher keli hu! misgarto lematta hayta.
Hanicha leman deamar misgarto lematta hayta, ella leman deamar misgarto lemala hayta, may ikka lememar? hay hechsher keli hu!
Ella: danin davar shennatna bo tora midda middavar shennatna bo tora midda, veal yochichu tzitz vezer, shello nittena bahen tora midda kelal.
Rav huna amar, mehacha: "al pene hakkapporet kedma", veen panim pachot mittefach.
Veema keappe
b: Devar yochani! tafasta merubbe lo tafasta, tafasta muat tafasta. veema keappe detzipparta dezutar tuva! amar rav acha bar yaakov: rav huna "pene" "pene" gamar. ketiv hacha: "el pene hakkapporet", uchetiv hatam: "meet pene yitzchak aviv".
Venelaf mippanim shel mala, dichtiv: "kirot pene elohim vattirtzeni"! tafasta merubbe lo tafasta, tafasta muat tafasta.
Venelaf mikkeruv, dichtiv: "el hakkapporet yihyu pene hakkeruvim"!
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: gemiri en pene cheruvim pechutin mittefach, verav huna name mehacha gemir.
Umay keruv? amar rabbi avahu: keravya, shekken bevavel korin leyanoka ravya.
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, dichtiv: "pene haechad pene hakkeruv ufene hashsheni pene adam", hayeynu keruv hayeynu adam! appe ravreve veappe zutere.
Umimmay dachalala asara bar missechacha? ema bahade sechacha!

Ella mibbet olamim gamar, dichtiv: "vehabbayit asher bana hammelech shelomo laAdonai shishshim amma orko veesrim rochbo usheloshim amma komato". uchetiv: "komat hakkeruv haechad eser baamma vechen hakkeruv hashsheni", vetanya: ma matzinu bevet olamim keruvim bishlish habbayit hen omdin. mishkan name — keruvim shelish habbayit hen omdin.

Mishkan kamma have — eser ammot, dichtiv: "eser ammot orech hakkaresh", kamma have lehu — shittin pusheche, tilteh kamma have — esrim pusheche, dal asra dearon vechapporet, pashu lehu asra, uchetiv: "vehayu hakkeruvim porse chenafayim lemala sochchim bechanfehem al hakkapporet", karyeh rachamana sechacha lemala measara.
Mimmay degaddefinhu illave reshayyhu kayymi, dilma lahade reshayyhu kayymi! amar rav acha bar yaakov: "lemala" ketiv. veema demiddele tuva? mi ketiv "lemala lemala"?
Hanicha lerabbi meir, deamar: kol haammot hayu benoniyyot. ella lerabbi yehuda deamar, amma shel binyan shishsha tefachim, veshel kelim chamishsha — may ikka lememar?
Aron vechapporet kamma have lehu? temanya ufalga, pashu lehu chad sere ufalga, ema sukka ad dehavya chad sere ufalga!
Ella, lerabbi yehuda hilcheta gemiri la. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: shiurin, chatzitzin, umechitzin — halacha lemoshe missinay.
Shiurin deorayyta ninhu! dichtiv: "eretz chitta useora vegefen uteena verimmon eretz zet shemen udevash", veamar rav chanin: kol happasuk hazze leshiurin neemar!
Chitta — levayit hamenugga, ditnan: hannichnas levayit hammenugga vechelav al ketefav, vesandalav vetabbeotav beyado — hu vahen temein miyyad.

a: Haya lavush kelav vesandalav beraglav vetabbeotav beetzbeotav — hu tame miyyad, vehen tehorim ad sheyyishhe bichde achilat peras, pat chittin velo pat seorin, mesev veochel beliftan.
Seora — ditnan: etzem kisora — metamme bemagga uvemassa, veeno metamme beohel.
Gefen — kede reviit yayin lenazir.
Teena — kigrogeret lehotzaat shabbat.
Rimmon — ditnan: kol kele baale vattim — shiuran kerimmonim.
"Eretz zet shemen (udevash)" — eretz shekkol shiureha kezetim. "kol shiureha" salka datach?! ha ikka hane deamrinan! ella ema: sherov shiureha kezetim.
Devash — kechotevet haggassa beyom hakkippurim.
Alma deorayyta ninhu! vetisbera? shiurin mi ketivi? ella hilcheta ninhu, ukera asmachta bealma hu.
Chatzitzin deorayyta ninhu! dichtiv: "verachatz (et besaro) bammayim", shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hammayim!
Ki atay hilcheta — lisaro, kidrabba bar bar chana. deamar rabba bar bar chana: nima achat keshura — chotzetzet, shalosh — enan chotztzot, shetayim — eni yodea.
