Searo name deorayyta ninhu, dichtiv: "verachatz et besaro bammayim", et hattafel livsaro, umay nihu — searo!
Ki atay hilcheta, lechidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak:
b: Devar tora, rubbo umakpid alav — chotzetz, vesheeno makpid alav — eno chotzetz. vegazru al rubbo sheeno makpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid, veal miuto hammakpid mishshum rubbo hammakpid.
Veligzar name al miuto sheeno makpid mishshum miuto hammakpid, i name mishshum rubbo sheeno makpid!
Hi gufa gezera, vaanan nekum venigzor gezera ligzera?!
Mechitzin — ha daamaran. hanicha lerabbi yehuda, ella lerabbi meir — may ikka lememar?
Ki atay hilcheta — legud, velavud, vedofen akumma.
Vesheen lah shalosh defanot.
Tanu rabbanan: shetayim kehilchatan, ushelishit afillu tefach. rabbi shimon omer: shalosh kehilchatan, ureviit afillu tefach.
Bemay kamippalgi? rabbanan savri: yesh em lammasoret, verabbi shimon savar: yesh em lammikra.
Rabbanan savri: yesh em lammasoret, "besukkat" "besukkat" "bassukkot" — hare kan arba.
Dal chad legufeh, pashu lehu telata. shetayim kehilchatan, vaatay hilcheta ugerata lishlishit veokemta attefach.

Rabbi shimon savar: yesh em lammikra, "bassukkot" "bassukkot" "bassukkot" — hare kan shesh, dal chad kera legufeh, pashu lehu arba. shalosh kehilchatan, atay hilcheta ugerata lirviit veokemta attefach.
Vei baet ema: dechulle alma yesh em lammikra, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar: sechacha baaya kera, umar savar: sechacha la baaya kera.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma yesh em lammasoret, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar: ki atay hilcheta — legarea. umar savar: ki atay hilcheta — lehosif.
Veibbaet ema: dechulle alma, ki atay hilcheta — legarea, veyesh em lammasoret. vehacha bedorshin techillot kamippalgi: mar savar: dorshin techillot, umar savar: en dorshin techillot.
Rav matna amar: tameh derabbi shimon mehacha: "vesukka tihye letzel yomam mechorev ulemachse ulemistor mizzerem umimmatar".
Veoto tefach hechan maamido? amar rav: maamido keneged hayyotze.
Amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav:

a: Veyaamidennu keneged rosh tor?! shetek rav.
Ittemar name, amar shemuel mishshemeh delevi: maamido keneged hayyotze. vechen morin be midresha: maamido keneged hayyotze.
Rabbi simon, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: ose lo tefach sochek, umaamido befachot mishshelosha tefachim samuch laddofen, vechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laddofen kelavud dame.
Amar rav yehuda: sukka haasuya kemavoy — keshera, veoto tefach maamido lechol ruach sheyyirtze.
Rabbi simon, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar: ose lo pas arbaa umashshehu, umaamido befachot mishshelosha samuch laddofen, vechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laddofen kelavud dame.

Umay shena hatam dekaamrat saggi tefach sochek, umay shena hacha dekaamrat baaya pas arbaa? hatam deikka shete defanot kehilchatan — saggi leh betefach sochek, hacha delekka shete defanot, i ikka pas arbaa — en, i la — la.
Amar rava: veenah nitteret ella betzurat happetach.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: venitteret name betzurat happetach.
Ikka deamri, amar rava: utzericha name tzurat happetach.

Rav ashe ashkecheh lerav kahana deka aved tefach sochek, veka aved tzurat happetach. amar leh: la savar mar leha derava, deamar rava: venitteret name betzurat happetach? amar leh: ana keiddach lishshana derava sevira li. deamar rava: utzericha name tzurat happetach.
Shetayim kehilchatan kulei. amar rava: vechen leshabbat, miggo dehavya dofen leinyan sukka — havya dofen leinyan shabbat.
Etiveh abbaye: umi amrinan miggo? vehatanya: dofen sukka kedofen shabbat, uvilvad shello yehe ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim.
Vitera, shabbat al sukka, shehashshabbat enah nitteret ella beomed merubbe al happarutz, ma sheen ken besukka.
May lav: yetera shabbat desukka assukka, vela amrinan miggo!
La: yetera shabbat dealma al shabbat desukka.
I hachi, litne name: yetera sukka dealma assukka deshabbat, deillu sukka dealma baaya tefach sochek, veillu sukka deshabbat la baaya tefach sochek, vesaggi belechi.
Deha at hu deamrat: sikkech al gabbe mavoy sheyyesh lo lechi — kasher!
Hahu la itztericha leh, hasheta mikkilleta lachamirta amrinan, mechamirta lekilleta lo kol shekken.
Gufa. amar rava:
b: Sikkech al gabbe mavoy sheyyesh lo lechi — keshera.
Veamar rava: sikkech al gabbe passe veraot — keshera.
Utzericha. dei ashmeinan mavoy, mishshum deikka shete defanot mealleyayta. aval gabbe passe veraot, delekka shete defanot mealleyayta — ema la.
Vei ashmeinan passe veraot, mishshum deikka shem arba defanot, aval sikkech al gabbe mavoy, delekka shem arba defanot — ema la.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte, mechamirta lekilleta, aval mikkilleta lachamirta — ema la, tzericha.
Veshechamatah merubba metzillatah — pesula.
Tanu rabbanan: chamatah mechamat sikkuch, velo mechamat defanot. rabbi yoshiyya omer: af mechamat defanot.

Amar rav yemar bar shelemya mishshemeh deabbaye: may tameh derabbi yoshiyya, dichtiv: "vesakkota al haaron et happarochet", parochet mechitza, veka karyeh rachamana "sechacha", alma mechitza kischach baenan.
Verabbanan? hahu denikkof bay pureta, demichaze kischach.
Amar abbaye: rabbi, verabbi yoshiyya, verabbi yehuda, verabbi shimon, verabban gamliel, uvet shammay, verabbi eliezer, vaacherim — kullehu sevira lehu: sukka dirat keva baenan.
Rabbi — detanya, rabbi omer: kol sukka sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot — pesula.
Rabbi yoshiyya — ha daamaran.
Rabbi yehuda ditnan sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma pesula rabbi yehuda machshir
Verabbi shimon — detanya: shetayim kehilchatan ushelishit afillu tefach, rabbi shimon omer: shalosh kehilchatan ureviit afillu tefach.
Rabban gamliel — detanya: haose sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassefina, rabban gamliel posel, verabbi akiva machshir.
Bet shammay — ditnan: mi shehaya rosho verubbo bassukka veshulechano betoch habbayit, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin.
Rabbi eliezer — ditnan: haose sukkato kemin tzerif, o shessemachah lechotel, rabbi eliezer posel lefi sheen lah gag, vachachamim machshirin.
Acherim — detanya, acherim omrim: sukka haasuya keshovach — pesula, lefi sheen lah zaviyyot.
Amar rabbi yochanan: sukka haasuya kechivshan, im yesh behekkefah kede leshev bah esrim vearbaa bene adam — keshera, veim lav — pesula.
Keman — kerabbi, deamar: kol sukka sheen bah arba ammot al arba ammot pesula.
Mikkedi, gavra beammeta yatev, kol sheyyesh behekkefo shelosha tefachim yesh bo rochav tefach, bitresar saggi?

a: Hane mille beiggula, aval beribbua — baaya tefe.
Mikkede kamma merubba yoter al haiggul — revia, beshittesar saggi?
Hane mille beiggul denafek miggo ribbua, aval ribbua denafek miggo iggula — baenan tefe, mishshum muresha dekarnata.
Mikkede kol ammeta beribbua ammeta utere chumeshe baalachsona, beshivsar neche chumesha saggi? la dak.
Emor deamrinan la dak pureta, tuva mi amrinan la dak?
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: mi savrat gavra beammeta yatev, telata gavre betarte ammeta yatvi. kamma havu lehu — shittesar, anan shivsar neche chumesha baenan! la dak.
Emor deamrinan la dak lechumera, lekulla mi amrinan la dak?
Amar leh rav assi lerav ashe: leolam gavra beammeta yatev, verabbi yochanan mekom gavre la kachashev.
Kamma havu lehu — tamne sere, beshivsar neche chumesha saggi! hayeynu dela dak ulechumera la dak.
Rabbanan dekesari, veamri la dayyayne dekesari amri: iggula denafek miggo ribbua — riva,
b: Ribbua denafek miggo iggula — palga. vela hi, deha kachazenan dela have kulle hay.
Amar rabbi levi mishshum rabbi meir: shete sukkot shel yotzrim zo lifnim mizzo — happenimit enah sukka, vechayyevet bimzuza. vehachitzona sukka, ufetura min hammezuza.
Veammay? tihve chitzona kevet shaar happenimit, vetitchayyev bimzuza! mishshum dela kevia.
Tanu rabbanan: ganba"ch: sukkat goyim, sukkat nashim, sukkat behema, sukkat kutim sukka mikkol makom — keshera, uvilvad shettehe mesukkechet kehilchatah.
May "kehilchatah"? amar rav chisda: vehu sheasaah letzel sukka.

"Mikkol makom" leetoye may? leetoye: sukkat rakba"sh. detanu rabbanan: sukkat rakba"sh: sukkat roim, sukkat kayyaytzim sukkat bureganin sukkat shomre ferot, sukka mikkol makom — keshera, uvilvad shettehe mesukkechet kehilchatah.
May "kehilchatah"? amar rav chisda: vehu sheasaah letzel sukka.
"Mikkol makom" leetoye may? leetoye: sukkat ganba"ch.
Hay tanna deganba"ch, allima leh ganba"ch mishshum dikvii, veka tane "mikkol makom" leetoye rakba"sh, dela kevii.
Vehay tanna derakba"sh, allima leh rakba"sh, divne chiyyuva ninhu, vetane "mikkol makom" leetoye ganba"ch, delav bene chiyyuva ninhu.

a: Mishna sukka yeshana — bet shammay poslin uvet hillel machshirin. veezo hi sukka yeshana, kol sheasaah kodem lechag sheloshim yom. aval im asaah leshem chag, afillu mittechillat hashshana — keshera.
Gemara may tamayyhu devet shammay? amar kera: "chag hassukkot shivat yamim laAdonai", sukka haasuya leshem chag baenan.
Uvet hillel? hahu mibbee leh lechidrav sheshet. deamar rav sheshet mishshum rabbi akiva: minnayin laatze sukka sheasurin kol shiva — talmud lomar: "chag hassukkot shivat yamim laAdonai",

Vetanya, rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: keshem shechal shem shamayim al hachagiga, kach chal shem shamayim al hassukka, shenneemar: "chag hassukkot shivat yamim laAdonai", ma chag laAdonai — af sukka laAdonai.
Uvet shammay name mibbee leh lehachi! in hachi name,
Ella may tamayyhu devet shammay — ketiv kera acharina: "chag hassukkot taase lecha shivat yamim", sukka haasuya leshem chag baenan.
Uvet hillel — hahu mibbee leh leosin sukka bechullo shel moed.
Uvet shammay — sevira lehu kerabbi eliezer, deamar: en osin sukka bechullo shel moed.
Uvet hillel let lehu derav yehuda amar rav? deamar rav yehuda amar rav: asaah min hakkotzin umin hannimin umin haggeradin — pesula. min hassisin — keshera,
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: af min hassisin name pesula, (alma) devaenan teviyya lishmah. hacha name baenan sukka asuya lishmah!
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "gedilim taase lach", lach — leshem chovach. hacha name: "chag hassukkot taase lecha", lach — leshem chovach!
Hahu mibbee leh lemaote gezula. hatam name mibbee leh lemaote gezula!
Hatam ketiv kera acharina: "veasu lahem" — mishshellahem.
b: Mishna haose sukkato tachat hailan — keillu asaah betoch habbayit. sukka al gabbe sukka — haelyona keshera vehattachtona pesula. rabbi yehuda omer: im en dayorin baelyona — hattachtona keshera.
Gemara amar rava: lo shanu ella beilan shetztzillato merubba mechamato, aval chamato merubba mitztzillato — keshera.

Mimmay — middekatane: "keillu asaah betoch habbayit": lema li lemitne "keillu asaah betoch habbayit"? litne "pesula"! ella, ha ka mashma lan deilan dumeya devayit: ma bayit tzillato merubba mechamato — af ilan tzillato merubba mechamato.
Vechi chamato merubba mitztzillato, may have? ha ka mitztaref sechach pasul bahade sechach kasher! amar rav pappa: beshechavatan.
I beshechavatan may lememra! mahu detema: nigzor hecha dachavatan attu hecha delo chavatan, ka mashma lan dela gazrinan.
Ha name tenena: hidla aleha: et haggefen veet haddelaat veet hakkisos, vesikkech al gabban — pesula, veim haya sikkuch harebe mehen o shekketzatzan — keshera.

Hechi dame? illema beshello chavatan, ha ka mitztaref sechach pasul im sechach kasher! ella lav, keshechavatan, ushema minna dela gazrinan! mahu detema: hane mille bediavad — aval lechattechilla la, ka mashma lan.
Sukka al gabbe sukka vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "(bassukkot) teshvu", velo besukka shettachat hassukka, velo besukka shettachat hailan, velo besukka shebbetoch habbayit.
Adderabba: "bassukkot" tarte mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "basukkot" ketiv.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: peamim sheshshetehen kesherot, peamim sheshshetehen pesulot, peamim shettachtona keshera vehaelyona pesula, peamim shettachtona pesula vehaelyona keshera.
Peamim sheshshetehen kesherot hechi dame? kegon shettachtona chamatah merubba mitztzillatah, vehaelyona tzillatah merubba mechammatah, vekayyma elyona betoch esrim.
Peamim sheshshetehen pesulot hechi dame? kegon detarvayyhu tzillatan merubba mechamatan, vekayyma elyona lemala meesrim amma.
Peamim shettachtona keshera vehaelyona pesula

a: Hechi dame? kegon shehattachtona tzillatah merubba mechammatah, veelyona chamatah merubba mitztzillatah, vekayymi tarvayyhu betoch esrim.
Ufeamim shehaelyona keshera vetachtona pesula hechi dame? kegon detarvayyhu tzillatan merubba mechamatan, vekayyma elyona betoch esrim.
Peshita! tachtona keshera veelyona pesula itztericha leh. mahu detema: nigzar dilma mitztaref sechach pasul bahade sechach kasher, ka mashma lan.
Kamma yehe ben sukka lesukka. utehe tachtona pesula?
Amar rav huna: tefach, shekken matzinu beohole tumea tefach. (detanya:) tefach al tefach berum tefach — mevi et hattumea, vechotzetz bifne hattumea. aval pachot merum tefach — lo mevi, velo chotzetz.
Verav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri: arbaa, shello matzinu makom [chashuv] pachot mearbaa.
Ushemuel amar: asara. may tama dishmuel — kehechsherah kach pesulah. ma hechsherah baasara, af pesulah baasara.
Tenan, rabbi yehuda omer: im en dayorin baelyona — hattachtona keshera.

May en dayorin? illema dayorin mammash: attu dayorin ka garmi? ella lav, may en dayorin — kol sheenah reuya ledira, vehechi dame? dela gevoha asara. mikkelal detanna kamma savar af al pi sheenah reuya ledira pesula.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar, amri bemareva: im en hattachtona yechola lekabbel karim uchesatot shel elyona — hattachtona keshera.
Mikkelal detanna kamma savar af al pi sheenah reuya lekabbel pesula?
Ikka benayyhu dichola lekabbel al yede haddechak.
Mishna peras aleha sadin mippene hachamma, o tachteha mippene hannesher, o shepperas al gabbe hakkinof — pesula. aval pores hu al gabbe naklite hammitta.

Gemara amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella mippene hannesher. aval lenaotah — keshera. peshita, mippene hannesher tenan! mahu detema: hu haddin daafillu lenaotah, vehay dekatane mippene hannesher — orcha demilleta katane, ka mashma lan.

Lema mesayyay leh: sikkechah kehilchatah veitterah bikramin uvisdinin hametzuyyarin, vetala bah egozin shekedim afarsekin verimmonim, parkile anavim vaatarot shel shibbolin, yenot shemanim uselatot — asur lehistappek mehen
b: Ad motzae yom tov haacharon shel chag. veim hitna alehem — hakkol lefi tenao. dilma min hatztzad.
Ittemar: noye sukka en memaatin bassukka. amar rav ashe: umin hatztzad — memaatin.

Minyamin avdeh derav ashe ittemisha leh kittuneta bemayya, veashtecha ammetallalta. amar leh rav ashe: dalyay, dela lemru ka mesakkechi bedavar hamekabbel tumea. veha ka chazu lay derattiva! lechi yavsha kaamena lach.
Ittemar: noye sukka hammufelagin mimmenna arbaa, rav nachman amar: keshera, rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri: pesula.

Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna ikkelau leve resh galuta. agninhu rav nachman besukka shennoyeha mufelagin mimmenna arbaa tefachim, ishtiku vela amaru leh vela midde. amar lehu: hadur behu rabbanan mishshematayyhu? amaru leh: anan sheluche mitzva anan, ufeturin min hassukka.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar lishan bechilla bassukka, af al pi sheyyesh lah gag, vehu sheenah gevoha asara.
Ta shema: hayyashen bechilla bassukka — lo yatza yede chovato! hacha bemay askinan, kesheggevoha asara.
Metivi: hayyashen tachat hammitta bassukka — lo yatza yede chovato! ha targema shemuel bemitta gevoha asara.
Ta shema: o shepperas al gabbe kinofot — pesula! hatam name digvihi asara.

Veha la katane hachi. detanya: naklitin shenayim, vekinofot arbaa. peras al gabbe kinofot — pesula, al gabbe naklitin — keshera, uvilvad shello yihyu naklitin gevohin min hammitta asara. mikkelal dekinofot — af al pi sheen gevohin asara!
Shane kinofot, dikvii. vahare sukka al gabbe sukka dikvia, veamar shemuel: kehechsherah kach pesulah! amri: hatam, dilmifsal sukka — baasara. hacha, dilshauoye uhela — betzir measara name have uhela.
Amar rav tachlifa bar avimi amar shemuel: hayyashen bechilla arom — motzi rosho chutz lakkila vekore keriat shema.
Metivi: hayyashen bechilla arom — lo yotzi rosho chutz lakkila veyikra keriat shema! hacha bemay askinan — kesheggevoha asara.
Hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: ha lema ze dome? leomed bevayit arom, shello yotzi rosho chutz lachallon veyikra keriat shema. shema minna.
